definition: Location  (a single type of diffuser can be used for multiple locations); high means close to ceiling.

name: Security Requirement

name: Privacy Requirement

name: Occupancy Type
definition: Occupancy type for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

name: Occupancy Number
definition: Number of people required for the activity assigned to this space.

name: Fail Position
definition: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

name: Manual Override
definition: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.

name: Stroke

name: Low Limit Enable

name: Event Enable

name: Notify Type

name: Polarity
definition: Enumeration defining the polarity

name: Inactive Text

name: Active Text

name: Minimum Off Time
definition: Minimum off time

name: Minimum On Time

name: Acked Transitions
definition: Enumeration that defines the type of transition acknowledgement

name: Alarm Value

name: Control Type
definition: The type of control used to operate the damper (e.g., Open/Closed Indicator, Resetable Temperature Sensor, Temperature Override, etc.)

name: Signal Offset

name: Signal Factor

name: Signal Time

name: Signal Factor2

name: Signal Time1

name: Signal Time2

name: Band Width
definition: Dead band for controller

name: Pressure Gauge Type
definition: Identifies the means by which pressure is displayed.

name: Display Size
definition: The physical size of the display. In the case of a stem thermometer, this will be the length of the stem. For a dial thermometer, it will be the diameter of the dial.

name: Thermometer Type
definition: Identifies the means by which temperature is displayed.

name: Number Of States

name: State Text

name: Alarm Values

name: Sound Sensor Set Point

name: Sound Sensor Range
definition: The upper and lower bounds for operation of the sound sensor.

name: Sound Sensor Accuracy
definition: The accuracy of the sensor.

name: Temperature Sensor Type

definition: The temperature value to be sensed.

name: Temperature Sensor Range
definition:
The upper and lower bounds for operation of the temperature sensor.

name: Accuracy Of Temperature Sensor

definition: The nominal length of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Width
definition: The nominal width of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Height
definition: The nominal height of the system furniture elements of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Ladder Configuration
definition: Description of the configuration of the ladder structure used.

name: Has Cover
definition: Indication of whether the cable tray has a cover (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE). By default, this value should be set to FALSE.

name: Number Of Compartments
definition: The number of separate internal compartments within the trunking

name: Conduit Shape Type
definition: The shape of the conduit segment

name: Is Rigid
definition: Indication of whether the conduit is rigid (= TRUE) or flexible (= FALSE)

name: Cross Sectional Area
definition: Cross section area of the phase(s) lead(s)

name: Nominal Width Or Diameter
definition:
The nominal width or, in the case of a horizontal cylindrical tank, the nominal diameter of the tank.

Note: Not required for a vertical cylindrical tank.

name: Normal Operating Temperature
definition: Normal operating temperature for the cable, busbar.

name: Max Operating Temperature
definition: Maximum operating temperature for the cable.

name: Cable Insulation Material
definition: The material from which the insulation is constructed. Such as PVC, PEX, EPR,...

name: Sheath Color
definition: Colour code on cable, conductor.

name: Electrical Conductor Function
definition: Type of function for which the conductor is intended.

name: Phase Reference
definition: The phase identification used for the device electrical input. This should be the same phase identifier that is used for the conductor segment providing the electrical service to the device. In general, it is recommended that IEC recommendations for phase identification are used (L1, L2 etc.). However, other phase identifiers may be used such as by color (Red, Blue, Yellow) or by number (1, 2, 3) etc.

name: Conductor Material
definition: Type of material from which the conductor is constructed. Such as Aluminium or Copper

name: Conductor Sheath Material
definition: The material from which the sheath or insulation is constructed. Such as EPR, Copper, MICC, PVC, PEX, Rubber, XPLE, XPLE_LS. Note that materials used should be agreed between exchange participants before use.

name: Maximum Operating Temperature
definition: The maximum temperature at which the sheath retains its integrity.

name: Is Fire Resistant
definition: Indication of whether the sheath is fire resistant (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Diversity
definition: A factor that is a means of reducing the cable size on the basis that not all the connected load will be drawing current simultaneously.

name: Number Of Phases
definition: Number of phases within this circuit.

name: Maximum Allowed Voltage Drop
definition: The maximum voltage drop across the circuit that must not be exceeded.

name: Net Impedance
definition: The maximum earth loop impedance of a circuit (typically stated as the variable Zs)

name: Nominal Current
definition: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

name: Usage Current
definition: The current that a device is actually handling or is calculated to be handling at a point in time.

name: Nominal Voltage
definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

name: Electrical Device Nominal Power
definition: The output power rating that is certified for a device.

name: Number Of Poles
definition: The number of logical connections that can be made on an electrical device.

name: Has Protective Earth
definition: Indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Nominal Frequency Range
definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

name: Phase Angle
definition: The angular difference between two waveforms of the same frequency

name: IP_Code
definition: IEC 529 (1989) Classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)

name: Insulation Standard Class
definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

name: Is Main
definition: Indicates whether the meter is the main meter on the system. If FALSE, it is a submeter.

name: Number Of Doors
definition: Number of doors

name: Case Material
definition: Material from which the casing surrounding the distribution point is constructed.

name: Case Weight
definition: Weight of case

name: Number Of Openings
definition: Maximum number of openings that can fit with the case for normal use. In the openings there must be nipples, so cable may run through.

name: Electric Generator Efficiency
definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

name: Start Current Factor
definition: IEC. Start current factor defines how large the peak starting current will become on the engine. StartCurrentFactor is multiplied to NominalCurrent and to give the start current.

name: Maximum Power Output
definition: The maximum output power rating of the engine.

name: Heat Output Per Unit Length
definition: The amount of heat output per unit length of heat emitter.

name: Heat Output Per Unit Area
definition: The amount of heat output per unit area of heat emitter.

name: Heat Output
definition: Total nominal heat output as listed by the Boiler manufacturer. For water boilers, it is a function of inlet versus outlet temperature. For steam boilers, it is a function of inlet temperature versus steam pressure.

name: Motor Enclosure Type
definition: A list of the available types of motor enclosure from which that required may be selected.

name: Is Guarded
definition: Indication of whether the motor enclosure is guarded (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Has Part Winding
definition: Indication of whether the motor is single speed, i.e. has a single winding (= FALSE) or multi-speed i.e.has part winding (= TRUE)

name: Frame Size
definition: Designation of the frame size according to the named range of frame sizes designated at the place of use or according to a given standard.

name: Electric Motor Efficiency
definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

name: Locked Rotor Current
definition: Input current when a motor armature is energized but not rotating.

name: Contributed Luminous Flux
definition: Luminous flux is a photometric measure of radiant flux, i.e. the volume of light emitted from a light source. Luminous flux is measured either for the interior as a whole or for a part of the interior (partial luminous flux for a solid angle). All other photometric parameters are derivatives of luminous flux. Luminous flux is measured in lumens (lm). The luminous flux is given as a nominal value for each lamp.

name: Light Emitter Nominal Power
definition: Light emitter nominal power.

name: Lamp Maintenance Factor
definition: Non recoverable losses of luminous flux of a lamp due to lamp depreciation; i.e. the decreasing of light output of a luminaire due to aging and dirt.

name: Lamp Ballast Type
definition:
The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps. 
Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional   (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).

name: Lamp Compensation Type
definition: Identifies the form of compensation used for power factor correction and radio suppression.

name: Color Appearance
definition: In both the DIN and CIE standards, artificial light sources are classified in terms of their color appearance. To the human eye they all appear to be white; the difference can only be detected by direct comparison. Visual performance is not directly affected by differences in color appearance.

name: Spectrum
definition: The spectrum of radiation describes its composition with regard to wavelength. Light, for example, as the portion of electromagnetic radiation that is visible to the human eye, is radiation with wavelengths in the range of approx. 380 to 780 nm (1 nm = 10 m). The corresponding range of colours varies from violet to indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red. These colours form a continuous spectrum, in which the various spectral sectors merge into each other.

name: Color Temperature
definition: The color temperature of any source of radiation is defined as the temperature (in Kelvin) of a black-body or Planckian radiator whose radiation has the same chromaticity as the source of radiation. Often the values are only approximate color temperatures as the black-body radiator cannot emit radiation of every chromaticity value. The color temperatures of the commonest artificial light sources range from less than 3000K (warm white) to 4000K (intermediate) and over 5000K (daylight).

name: Color Rendering Index
definition: The CRI indicates how well a light source renders eight standard colors compared to perfect reference lamp with the same color temperature. The CRI scale ranges from 1 to 100, with 100 representing perfect rendering properties.

name: Number Of Sources
definition: Number of sources

name: Total Wattage
definition: Wattage on whole lightfitting device with all sources intact.

name: Light Fixture Mounting Type
definition: A list of the available types of mounting for light fixtures from which that required may be selected.

name: Light Fixture Placing Type
definition: A list of the available types of placing specification for light fixtures from which that required may be selected.

name: Maintenance Factor
definition: Maintenance factor.

name: Manufacturers Specific Information
definition: Manufacturer specific information.

name: Article Number
definition: Article number or reference that may be applied to a product according to a standard scheme for article number definition (e.g. UN, EAN)

name: Minimum Text Height
definition: The minlimum height of this type.

name: Self Test Function
definition: The type of self test function.

name: Backup Supply System
definition: The type of backup supply system.

name: Pictogram Escape Direction
definition: The direction of escape pictogram.

name: Addressablility
definition: The type of addressability.

name: Maximum Plenum Sensible Load
definition: Maximum or Peak sensible thermal load contributed to the conditioned space by the light fixture.

name: Maximum Space Sensible Load
definition: Maximum or Peak sensible thermal load contributed to return air plenum by the light fixture.

name: Sensible Load To Radiant
definition: Percent of sensible thermal load to radiant heat.

name: Is Pluggable Outlet
definition: Indication of whether the outlet accepts a loose plug connection (= TRUE) or whether it is directly connected (= FALSE) or whether the form of connection has not yet been determined (= UNKNOWN)

name: Circuit Breaker Type
Rated Short Circuit Current
definition: An overcurrent resulting from a fault of negligible impedance between live conductors having a difference in potential under normal operating conditions. (IEC 826-05-08)

name: Cut Off Current
definition: The maximum instantaneous value of current attained during the breaking operation of a protective device. (IEC 441-17-12)

name: Maximum Rated Voltage
definition: Maximum rated voltage

name: Limiting Terminal Size
definition: The maximum terminal size capacity of the device.

name: Switching Duty
definition: The maximum number of operations for the device at the rated making and breaking capacity.

name: Characteristic Trip Curve
definition: A curve giving the time, e.g. prearcing time or operating time, as a function of the protective current under stated conditions of operation.

name: Protective Tag Type
definition: The breaking capacity value of the device. Note: This may be expressed as a code or a value depending on standard and/or source.

name: Standard Used
definition: The electrical standard used as a reference when preparing data for the device.

name: Earth Failure Device Type
Sensitivity
definition: Current leakage to an unwanted leading path during normal operation (IEC 151-14-49)

name: Fuse Disconnector Type
definition:
A list of the available types of fuse disconnector from which that required may be selected where:

EngineProtectionDevice - A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of a motor or generator.
FuseSwitchDisconnector - A switch disconnector in which a fuse link or a fuse carrier with fuse link forms the moving contact,
HRC - A standard fuse (High Rupturing Capacity)
OverloadProtectionDevice - A device that disconnects the supply when the operating conditions in an electrically undamaged circuit causes an overcurrent,
SemiconductorFuse - A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of sem-conductor devices.
SwitchDisconnectorFuse - A switch disconnector in which one or more poles have a fuse in series in a composite unit.

name: Varistor Type
definition: A list of the available types of varistor  from which that required may be selected.

name: Number Of Gangs
definition: Number of gangs/buttons on this switch

name: Switch Function
definition: Indicates types of switches which differs in functionality

name: Has Lock
definition: Indication of whether a switching device has a key operated lock (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Contactor Type
definition:
A list of the available types of contactor from which that required may be selected where:

CapacitorSwitching - for switching 3 phase single or multi-step capacitor banks
LowCurrent - requires the use of low resistance contacts
MagneticLatching - enables the contactor to remain in the on position when the coil is no longer energized
MechanicalLatching - requires that the contactor is mechanically retained in the on position
Modular - are totally enclosed and self contained
Reversing - has a double set of contactors that are prewired
Standard - is a generic device that controls the flow of power in a circuit on or off

name: Switch Operation
definition: Indicates operation of emergency stop switch.

name: Starter Type
definition:
A list of the available types of starter from which that required may be selected where:

AutoTransformer - A starter for an induction motor which uses for starting one or more reduced voltages derived from an auto transformer. (IEC 441-14-45)
Manual - A starter in which the force for closing the main contacts is provided exclusively by manual energy. (IEC 441-14-39)
DirectOnLine - A starter which connects the line voltage across the motor terminals in one step. (IEC 441-14-40)
Frequency - A starter in which the frequency of the power supply is progressively increased until the normal operation frequency is attained.
nStep - A starter in which there are (n-1) intermediate accelerating positions between the off and full on positions. (IEC 441-14-41)
Rheostatic - A starter using one or several resistors for obtaining, during starting, stated motor torque characteristics and for limiting the current. (IEC 441-14-425)
StarDelta - A starter for a 3 phase induction motor such that in the starting position the stator windings are connected in star and in the final running position they are connected in delta. (IEC 441-14-44)

name: Switch Disconnector Type
definition:
A list of the available types of switch disconnector from which that required may be selected where:

CenterBreak - A disconnector in which both contacts of each pole are movable and engage at a point substantially midway between their supports. (IEC 441-14-08)
DividedSupport - A disconnector in which the fixed and moving contacts of each pole are not supported by a common base or frame. (IEC 441-14-06)
DoubleBreak - A disconnector that opens a circuit at two points. (IEC 441-14-09)
EarthingSwitch - A disconnector in which the fixed and moving contacts of each pole are not supported by a common base or frame. (IEC 441-14-07)
Isolator - A disconnector which in the open position satisfies isolating requirements. (IEC 441-14-12)

name: Load Disconnection Type
definition: A list of the available types of load disconnection from which that required may be selected.

name: Has Visual Indication
definition: Indicates whether a means of being to visually ascertain whether the contacts are open or closed is fitted (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Toggle Switch Type
definition: A list of the available types of toggle switch from which that required may be selected.

name: Switch Usage
definition: A list of the available usages for toggle switches from which that required may be selected

name: Switch Activation
definition: A list of the available activations for toggle switches from which that required may be selected

name: Is Illuminated
definition: An indication of whether there is an illuminated indicator to show that the switch is on (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Legend
definition: A text inscribed or applied to the switch as a legend to indicate purpose or function.

name: Primary Voltage
definition: The voltage that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Secondary Voltage
definition: The voltage that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Primary Current
definition: The current that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Secondary Current
definition: The current that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Primary Frequency
definition: The frequency that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Secondary Frequency
definition: The frequency that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Primary Apparent Power
definition: The power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Secondary Apparent Power
definition: The power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Maximum Apparent Power
definition: Maximum apparent power/capacity in VA (volt ampere).

name: Secondary Current Type
definition: A list of the secondary current types that can result from transformer output

name: Request Source Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of sources through which a request can be made.

name: Request Source Label
definition: A specific name or label that further qualifies the identity of a request source. In the event of an email, this may be the email address.

name: Request Source Name
definition: The person making the request, where known.

name: Request Description
definition: The request description as provided.

name: Request Comments
definition: Comments that may be made on the request.

name: Status
definition:
The status currently assigned to the request where:
Hold = wait to see if further requests are received before deciding on action,
NoAction = no action is required on this request,
Schedule = plan action to take place as part of maintenance or other task planning/scheduling,
Urgent = take action immediately.

name: Packing Care Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of care that may be required when handling the artefact during a move where:

Fragile = artefact may be broken during a move through careless handling.
HandleWithCare = artefact may be damaged during a move through careless handling.

name: Wrapping Material
definition: Special requirements for material used to wrap an artefact.

name: Container Material
definition: Special requirements for material used to contain an artefact.

name: Special Instructions
definition: Special instructions that affect the move.

name: Permit Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of permits that can be granted where:

Access = enables access to an identified area,
Work = enables work to be carried out in an identified area

name: Escort Requirement
definition:
Indicates whether or not an escort is required to accompany persons carrying out a work order at or to/from the place of work (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

NOTE - There are many instances where escorting is required, particularly in a facility that has a high security rating. Escorting may require that persons are escorted to and from the place of work. Alternatively, it may involve the escort remaining at the place of work at all times.

name: Start Date
definition: Start date.

name: Permit Duration
definition: Permit duration.

name: Start Time
definition: Start time.

name: End Time
definition: End time.

name: Special Requirements
definition:
Any additional special requirements that need to be included in the permit to work.

NOTE - Additional permit requirements may be imposed according to the nature of the facility at which the work is carried out. For instance, in clean areas, special clothing may be required whilst in corrective institutions, it may be necessary to check in and check out tools that will be used for work as a safety precaution.

name: Damper Position
definition: Damper position (0-1); damper position ( 0=closed=90deg position angle, 1=open=0deg position angle.

name: Atmospheric Pressure
definition: Ambient atmospheric pressure.

name: Sound
definition: Sound performance.

name: Airflow Curve
definition: Air flowrate versus damper position relationship;airflow = f ( valve position).

name: Airflow Rate Range
definition: Possible range of airflow that can be delivered

name: Air Pressure Range
definition: Allowable air static pressure range at the entrance of the air terminal box.

name: Nominal Air Flow Rate
definition: Nominal rate of air flow into which water vapor is added.

name: Arrangement Type
definition:
Terminal box arrangement.
SingleDuct: Terminal box receives warm or cold air from a single air supply duct.
DualDuct: Terminal box receives warm and cold air from separate air supply ducts.

name: Reheat Type
definition: Terminal box reheat type.

name: Has Sound Attenuator
definition: If TRUE, the air terminal has sound attenuation.

name: Has Return Air
definition: Terminal box has return air mixed with supply air from duct work.

name: Has Fan
definition: Terminal box has a fan inside (fan powered box).

name: Nominal Inlet Air Pressure
definition: Nominal airflow inlet static pressure.

name: Nominal Damper Diameter
definition: Nominal damper diameter.

name: Material
definition: Main material of the covering, it should only be given, if no IfcMaterial class is assigned to the IfcCovering instance.

name: Housing Thickness
definition: Air terminal box housing material thickness.

name: Operation Temperature Range
definition: Allowable operation ambient fluid temperature range.

name: Return Air Fraction Range
definition: Allowable return air fraction range as a fraction of discharge airflow.

name: Weight
definition: The weight of the humidifier.

name: Air Flow Rate
definition: Volumetric air flow rate.

name: Neck Air Velocity
definition: Air velocity at the neck.

name: Supply Air Temperature Heating
definition: Supply air temperature in heating mode

name: Supply Air Temperature Cooling
definition: Supply air temperature in cooling mode

name: Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop.

name: Induction Ratio
definition: Induction ratio versus distance from the diffuser and its discharge direction; induction ratio (or entrainment ratio) is the ratio of the volumetric flow rate in the jet to the volumetric flow rate at the air terminal

name: Centerline Air Velocity
definition: Centerline air velocity versus distance from the diffuser and temperature differential; a function of distance from diffuser and temperature difference between supply air and room air.

name: Shape
definition: Cross sectional shape.

name: Flow Pattern
definition: Flow pattern

name: Air Flowrate Range
definition: Possible range of airflow that can be delivered.

name: Temperature Range
definition: Allowable operational range of the fluid temperature.

name: Discharge Direction
definition:
Discharge direction of the air terminal.
Parallel: discharges parallel to mounting surface designed so that flow attaches to the surface.
Perpendicular:  discharges away from mounting surface.
Adjustable: both parallel and perpendicular discharge.

name: Throw Length
definition: The horizontal or vertical axial distance an airstream travels after leaving an AirTerminal before the maximum stream velocity is reduced to a specified terminal velocity under isothermal conditions at the upper value of the AirFlowrateRange.

name: Air Diffusion Performance Index
definition: The Air Diffusion Performance Index (ADPI) is used for cooling mode conditions. If several measurements of air velocity and air temperature are made throughout the occupied zone of a space, the ADPI is the percentage of locations where measurements were taken that meet the specifications for effective draft temperature and air velocity.

name: Finish Type
definition: The type of finish for the air terminal.

name: Finish Color
definition: Finish color for cooled beam

name: Mounting Type
definition:
The way the air terminal is mounted to the ceiling, wall, etc.
Surface type is mounted to the surface of something (e.g., wall, duct, etc.).
Flat flush type is mounted flat and flush with a surface.
Lay-in type is mounted in a lay-in type ceiling (e.g., a dropped ceiling grid).

name: Core Type
definition: Identifies the way the core of the AirTerminal is constructed.

name: Core Set Horizontal
definition: Degree of horizontal (in the X-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

name: Core Set Vertical
definition: Degree of vertical (in the Y-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

name: Has Integral Control
definition: If TRUE, a self powered temperature control is included in the AirTerminal.

name: Flow Control Type
definition: Type of flow control element that may be included as a part of the construction of the air terminal.

name: Has Thermal Insulation
definition: If TRUE, the air terminal has thermal insulation.

name: Neck Area
definition: Neck area of the air terminal.

name: Effective Area
definition: Effective discharge area of the air terminal.

name: Air Flowrate Versus Flow Control Element
definition: Air flowrate versus flow control element position at nominal pressure drop.

name: Face Type
definition: Identifies how the terminal face of an AirTerminal is constructed.

name: Slot Width
definition: Slot width.

name: Slot Length
definition: Slot length.

name: Number Of Slots
definition: Number of slots.

name: Sensible Effectiveness
definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness, where effectiveness is defined as the ratio of heat transfer to maximum possible heat transfer.

name: Total Effectiveness
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of heat transfer to the maximum possible heat transfer.

name: Temperature Effectiveness
definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow temperature changes to maximum possible temperature changes.

name: Defrost Temperature Effectiveness
definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness when defrosting is active.

name: Humidity Effectiveness
definition: Humidity heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow absolute humidity changes to maximum possible absolute humidity changes.

name: Sensible Heat Transfer Rate
definition: Sensible heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

name: Latent Heat Transfer Rate
definition: Latent heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

name: Total Heat Transfer Rate
definition: Total heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

name: Sensible Effectiveness Table
definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

name: Total Effectiveness Table
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

name: Air Pressure Drop Curves
definition: Air pressure drop as function of air flow rate

name: Heat Transfer Type Enum
definition: Type of heat transfer between the two air streams.

name: Media Material
definition: Filter media material.

name: Has Defrost
definition: has the heat exchanger has defrost function or not

name: Operational Temperature Range
definition: Allowable operational air temperature range.

name: Primary Airflow Rate Range
definition: possible range of primary airflow that can be delivered

name: Secondary Airflow Rate Range
definition: possible range of secondary airflow that can be delivered

name: Energy Source Consumption
definition: Energy consumption.

name: Operational Efficiency
definition: Operational efficiency: boiler output divided by total energy input (electrical and fuel)

name: Combustion Efficiency
definition: Combustion efficiency under nominal condition

name: Working Pressure
definition: The normally expected maximum working pressure of the valve

name: Combustion Temperature
definition: Average combustion chamber temperature.

name: Part Load Ratio
definition: Ratio of the real to the nominal capacity.

name: Load
definition: Boiler real load

name: Primary Energy Consumption
definition: Boiler primary energy source consumption (i.e., the fuel consumed for changing the thermodynamic state of the fluid).

name: Auxiliary Energy Consumption
definition: Boiler secondary energy source consumption (i.e., the electricity consumed by electrical devices such as fans and pumps).

name: Pressure Rating
definition: Maximum pressure that the hydrant is manufactured to withstand.

name: Operating Mode
definition: Identifies the operating mode of the boiler.

name: Heat Transfer Surface Area
definition: Total heat transfer area of the vessel.

name: Nominal Part Load Ratio
definition: Allowable part load ratio range.

name: Water Inlet Temperature Range
definition: Allowable water inlet temperature range.

name: Water Storage Capacity
definition: Water storage capacity.

name: Is Water Storage Heater
definition: This is used to identify if the boiler has storage capacity (TRUE). If FALSE, then there is no storage capacity built into the boiler, such as an instantaneous hot water heater.

name: Partial Load Efficiency Curves
definition: Boiler efficiency as a function of the partial load factor; E = f (partialLaodfactor).

name: Nominal Efficiency
definition: Nominal chiller efficiency under nominal conditions.

name: Outlet Temperature Range
definition: Allowable outlet temperature of either the water or the steam.

name: Nominal Energy Consumption
definition: Nominal fuel consumption rate required to produce the total boiler heat output.

name: Maximum Outlet Pressure
definition: Maximum steam outlet pressure.

name: Capacity
definition: Cooling tower capacity in terms of heat transfer rate of the cooling tower between air stream and water stream.

name: Energy Efficiency Ratio
definition: Energy efficiency ratio (EER).

name: Coefficient Of Performance
definition: Coefficient of performance (COP).

name: Capacity Curve
definition: Chiller cooling capacity is a function of condensing temperature and evaporating temperature, data is in table form, Capacity = f (TempCon, TempEvp), capacity = a1+b1*Tei+c1*Tei^2+d1*Tci+e1*Tci^2+f1*Tei*Tci.

name: Coefficient Of Performance Curve
definition: Chiller coefficient of performance (COP) is function of condensing temperature and evaporating temperature, data is in table form,  COP= f (TempCon, TempEvp),  COP = a2+b2*Tei+c2*Tei^2+d2*Tci+e2*Tci^2+f2*Tei*Tci

name: Full Load Ratio Curve
definition: Ratio of actual power to full load power as a quadratic function of part load, at certain condensing and evaporating temperature, FracFullLoadPower = f ( PartLoadRatio).

name: Nominal Capacity
definition: The nominal or design volumetric capacity of the tank.

name: Nominal Condensing Temperature
definition: Chiller condensing temperature.

name: Nominal Evaporating Temperature
definition: Chiller evaporating temperature.

name: Nominal Heat Rejection Rate
definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

name: Nominal Power Consumption
definition: Nominal total power consumption.

name: Air Pressure Drop Curve
definition: Air pressure drop versus air-flow rate.

name: Sound Curve
definition: Regenerated sound versus air-flow rate.

name: Face Velocity
definition: Air velocity through the coil.

name: Nominal Sensible Capacity
definition: Nominal sensible capacity.

name: Nominal Latent Capacity
definition: Nominal latent capacity.

name: Nominal UA
definition: Nominal UA value.

name: Fluid Pressure Range
definition: Allowable water working pressure range inside the tube

name: Coil Coolant
definition: The fluid used for heating or cooling used by the hydronic coil.

name: Coil Connection Direction
definition: Coil connection direction (facing into the air stream).

name: Coil Fluid Arrangement
definition:
Fluid flow arrangement of the coil.
CrossCounterFlow: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
CrossParallelFlow: Air and water flow enter in same directions

name: Coil Face Area
definition: Coil face area in the direction against air the flow.

name: Heat Exchange Surface Area
definition: Heat exchange surface area associated with U-value.

name: Primary Surface Area
definition: Primary heat transfer surface area of the tubes and headers.

name: Secondary Surface Area
definition: Secondary heat transfer surface area created by fins.

name: Fluid
definition: The properties of the hydronic fluid used for heat transfer within the coil tubes.

name: Total UACurves
definition: Total UA curves, UA - air and water velocities, UA = [(C1 * AirFlowRate^0.8)^-1 + (C2 * WaterFlowRate^0.8)^-1]^-1.

name: Water Pressure Drop Curve
definition: Water pressure drop curve, pressure drop – flow rate curve, WaterPressureDrop = f(WaterflowRate).

name: Bypass Factor
definition: Fraction of air that is bypassed by the coil (0-1).

name: Sensible Heat Ratio
definition: Air-side sensible heat ratio, or fraction of sensible heat transfer to the total heat transfer.

name: Wet Coil Fraction
definition: Fraction of coil surface area that is wet (0-1).

name: Compressor Capacity
definition: The product of the  ideal capacity and the overall volumetric efficiency of the compressor.

name: Volumetric Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the actual volume of gas entering the compressor to the theoretical displacement of the compressor.

name: Compression Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to the work delivered to the gas within the compression volume (as obtained by measurement).

name: Mechanical Efficiency
definition: The pumps operational mechanical efficiency.

name: Isentropic Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to work input to the compressor shaft.

name: Compressor Total Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the thermal cooling capacity to electrical input.

name: Shaft Power
definition: The actual shaft power input to the compressor.

name: Input Power
definition: Input power to the compressor motor.

name: Lubricant Pump Heat Gain
definition: Lubricant pump heat gain.

name: Friction Heat Gain
definition: Friction heat gain.

name: Compressor Total Heat Gain
definition: Compressor total heat gain.

name: Power Source
definition: Type of power driving the compressor

name: Refrigerant Class
definition:
Refrigerant class used by the compressor.
CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

name: Refrigerant Type
definition: Refrigerant material.

name: Minimum Part Load Ratio
definition: Minimum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

name: Maximum Part Load Ratio
definition: Maximum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

name: Compressor Speed
definition: Compressor speed

name: Ideal Capacity
definition: Compressor capacity under ideal conditions.

name: Ideal Shaft Power
definition: Compressor shaft power under ideal conditions.

name: Has Hot Gas Bypass
definition: Whether or not hot gas bypass is provided for the compressor. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Heat Rejection Rate
definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

name: Exterior Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Exterior heat transfer coefficient associated with exterior surface area.

name: Interior Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Interior heat transfer coefficient associated with interior surface area.

name: Refrigerant Fouling Resistance
definition: Fouling resistance on the refrigerant side.

name: Condensing Temperature
definition: Refrigerant condensing temperature.

name: Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference
definition: Logarithmic mean temperature difference between refrigerant and water or air.

name: UAcurves
definition: UV = f (VExterior, VInterior), UV as a function of interior and exterior fluid flow velocity at the entrance.

name: Compressor Condenser Heat Gain
definition: Heat gain between condenser inlet to compressor outlet.

name: Compressor Condenser Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop between condenser inlet and compressor outlet.

name: Condenser Mean Void Fraction
definition: Mean void fraction in condenser.

name: Water Fouling Resistance
definition: Fouling resistance on water/air side.

name: External Surface Area
definition: External surface area (both primary and secondary area).

name: Internal Surface Area
definition: Internal surface area.

name: Internal Refrigerant Volume
definition: Internal volume of evaporator (refrigerant side).

name: Internal Water Volume
definition: Internal volume of evaporator (water side).

name: Nominal Heat Transfer Area
definition: Nominal heat transfer surface area associated with nominal overall heat transfer coefficient.

name: Nominal Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Nominal overall heat transfer coefficient associated with nominal heat transfer area.

name: Total Cooling Capacity
definition: Total cooling capacity. This includes cooling capacity of beam and cooling capacity of supply air

name: Total Heating Capacity
definition: Total heating capacity. This includes heating capacity of beam and heating capacity of supply air

name: Beam Cooling Capacity
definition: Cooling capacity of beam. This excludes cooling capacity of supply air

name: Beam Heating Capacity
definition: Heating capacity of beam. This excludes heating capacity of supply air

name: Cooling Water Flow Rate
definition: Water flow rate for cooling

name: Heating Water Flow Rate
definition: Water flow rate for heating

name: Correction Factor For Cooling
definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate cooling capacity)

name: Correction Factor For Heating
definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate heating capacity)

name: Water Pressure Drop Curves
definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate

name: Supply Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Supply water temperature in cooling mode

name: Return Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Return water temperature in cooling mode

name: Supply Water Temperature Heating
definition: Supply water temperature in heating mode

name: Return Water Temperature Heating
definition: Return water temperature in heating mode

name: Throw
definition: Distance cooled beam throws the air

name: Air Flow Configuration
definition: Air flow configuration type of cooled beam

name: Supply Air Connection Type
definition: The manner in which the pipe connection is made to the cooled beam.

name: Connection Size
definition: Size of the inlet connection to the sprinkler.

name: Is Free Hanging
definition: Is it free hanging type (not mounted in a false ceiling)?

name: Water Flow Control System Type
definition: Factory fitted waterflow control system

name: Water Pressure Range
definition: Allowable water circuit working pressure range.

name: Nominal Cooling Capacity
definition: Nominal cooling capacity

name: Nominal Surrounding Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity)

name: Nominal Surrounding Humidity Cooling
definition: Nominal surrounding humidity (refers to nominal cooling capacity)

name: Nominal Supply Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity)

name: Nominal Return Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity)

name: Nominal Water Flow Cooling
definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal cooling capacity)

name: Nominal Heating Capacity
definition: Nominal heating capacity

name: Nominal Surrounding Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity)

name: Nominal Supply Water Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity)

name: Nominal Return Water Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity)

name: Nominal Water Flow Heating
definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal heating capacity)

name: Integrated Lighting Type
definition: Integrated lighting in cooled beam

name: Pipe Connection Enum
definition: The manner in which the pipe connection is made to the cooled beam.

name: Coil Length
definition: Length of coil

name: Coil Width
definition: Width of coil

name: Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Heat transfer coefficient-area product.

name: Sump Heater Power
definition: Electrical heat power of sump heater.

name: UACurve
definition: UA curve as function of ambient temperature and surface temperature; UA = f (Tambient, Tsurface)

name: Performance
definition: Water temperature change as a function of wet-bulb temperature, water entering temperature, water flow rate, air flow rate, Tdiff = f ( Twet-bulb, Twater,in, mwater, mair).

name: Circuit Type
definition:
OpenCircuit: Exposes water directly to the cooling atmosphere.
CloseCircuit: The fluid is separated from the atmosphere by a heat exchanger.
Wet: The air stream or the heat exchange surface is evaporatively cooled.
Dry: No evaporation into the air stream.
DryWet: A combination of a dry tower and a wet tower.

name: Flow Arrangement
definition:
CounterFlow: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
ParallelFlow: Air and water flow enter in same directions.

name: Spray Type
definition:
SprayFilled: Water is sprayed into airflow.
SplashTypeFill: water cascades over successive rows of splash bars.
FilmTypeFill: water flows in a thin layer over closely spaced sheets.

name: Capacity Control
definition:
FanCycling: Fan is cycled on and off to control duty.
TwoSpeedFan: Fan is switched between low and high speed to control duty.
VariableSpeedFan: Fan speed is varied to control duty.
DampersControl: Dampers modulate the air flow to control duty.
BypassValveControl: Bypass valve modulates the water flow to control duty.
MultipleSeriesPumps: Turn on/off multiple series pump to control duty.
TwoSpeedPump: Switch between high/low pump speed to control duty.
VariableSpeedPump: vary pump speed to control duty

name: Control Strategy
definition:
FixedExitingWaterTemp: The capacity is controlled to maintain a fixed exiting water temperature.
WetBulbTempReset: The set-point is reset based on the wet-bulb temperature.

name: Number Of Cells
definition: Number of cells in one cooling tower unit.

name: Basin Reserve Volume
definition: Volume between operating and overflow levels in cooling tower basin.

name: Lift Elevation Difference
definition: Elevation difference between cooling tower sump and the top of the tower.

name: Water Requirement
definition: Make-up water requirement.

name: Casing Material
definition: Material from which the casing of the pump is constructed

name: Fill Material
definition: The material that is used to fill the duct (where used).

name: Ambient Design Dry Bulb Temperature
definition: Ambient design dry bulb temperature used for selecting the cooling tower.

name: Ambient Design Wet Bulb Temperature
definition: Ambient design wet bulb temperature used for selecting the cooling tower.

name: Leakage
definition: Air leakage rate.

name: Blade Position Angle
definition: Blade position angle; angle between the blade and flow direction ( 0 - 90).

name: Pressure Loss Coefficient
definition: Pressure loss coefficient.

name: Operation
definition: The operational mechanism for the damper operation.

name: Orientation
definition: The intended orientation for the damper as specified by the manufacturer.

name: Blade Material
definition: The material from which the damper blades are constructed.

name: Blade Thickness
definition: The thickness of the damper blade.

name: Seal Material
definition: The material from which the damper seals are constructed.

name: Blade Action
definition: Blade action.

name: Blade Shape
definition: Blade shape. Flat means triple V-groove.

name: Blade Edge
definition: Blade edge.

name: Numberof Blades
definition: Number of blades.

name: Face Area
definition: Face area open to the airstream.

name: Maximum Air Flow Rate
definition: Maximum allowable air flow rate.

name: Maximum Working Pressure
definition: Maximum pressure that the object is manufactured to withstand.

name: Temperature Rating
definition: Temperature rating.

name: Torque Range
definition: Torque range: minimum operational torque to maximum allowable torque.

name: Open Pressure Drop
definition: Total pressure drop across damper.

name: Leakage Fully Closed
definition: Leakage when fully closed.

name: Loss Coefficent Curve
definition: Loss coefficient – blade position angle curve; ratio of pressure drop to velocity pressure versus blade angle; C = f (blade angle position).

name: Leakage Curve
definition: Leakage per unit length curve versus working pressure.

name: Regenerated Sound Curve
definition: Regenerated sound versus air flow rate.

name: Frame Type
definition: The type of frame used by the damper (e.g., Standard, Single Flange, Single Reversed Flange, Double Flange, etc.).

name: Frame Depth
definition: The length (or depth) of the damper frame.

name: Frame Material
definition: The material used to construct the frame of the sprinkler.

name: Frame Thickness
definition: The thickness of the damper frame material.

name: Close Off Rating
definition: Close off rating.

name: Control Damper Operation
definition: The inherent characteristic of the control damper operation.

name: Actuation Type
definition: Enumeration that identifies the different types of dampers

name: Closure Rating Enum
definition: Enumeration that identifies the closure rating for the damper

name: Fire Resistance Rating
definition: Fire rating identifying the entity's fire resistive value (e.g., 1-hour, 2-hour, etc.) so that its resistance to fire can be compared to that of the surrounding structure.

name: Fusible Link Temperature
definition: The temperature that the fusible link melts

name: Connection Type
definition:
The end-style treatment of the pipe port:
BRAZED: Brazed. 
COMPRESSION: Compression. 
FLANGED: Flanged. 
GROOVED: Grooved. 
OUTSIDESLEEVE: Outside Sleeve. 
SOLDERED: Soldered. 
SWEDGE: Swedge. 
THREADED: Threaded. 
WELDED: Welded. 
OTHER: Another type of end-style has been applied.
NONE: No end-style has been applied.
USERDEFINED: User-defined port connection type. 
NOTDEFINED: Undefined port connection type.

name: Design Name
definition: A name for the design values

name: Duct Sizing Method
definition: Enumeration that identifies the methodology to be used to size system components

name: Pressure Class
definition: The test or rated pressure classification of the fitting.

name: Leakage Class
definition: Nominal leakage rating for the system components.

name: Friction Loss
definition: The pressure loss due to friction per unit length. (Data type = PressureMeasure/LengthMeasure)

name: Scrap Factor
definition: Sheet metal scrap factor

name: Duct Sealant
definition: Type of sealant used on the duct and fittings

name: Maximum Velocity
definition: The maximum design velocity of the air in the duct or fitting.

name: Aspect Ratio
definition: The default aspect ratio

name: Minimum Height
definition: The minimum duct height for rectangular, oval or round duct

name: Minimum Width
definition: The minimum duct width for oval or rectangular duct

name: Loss Coefficient
definition: Dimensionless loss coefficient used for calculating fluid resistance representing the ratio of total pressure loss to velocity pressure at a referenced cross-section.

name: Air Flow Leakage
definition: Volumetric leakage flow rate.

name: Sub Type
definition:
Subtype of the pipe fitting..The following suggested items should be utilized whenever possible for consistency across applications:
BEND_15DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 15 degrees. 
BEND_22_5DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 22.5 degrees. 
BEND_25DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 25 degrees. 
BEND_30DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 30 degrees. 
BEND_45DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 45 degrees. 
BEND_67DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 67 degrees. 
BEND_76DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 76 degrees. 
BEND_87_5DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 87.5 degrees. 
BEND_90DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 90 degrees. 
BEND_135DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 135 degrees. 
BEND_180DEGREE: Changes the direction of flow through 180 degrees. 
JUNCTION_CROSS_SQUARE: Branch fitting with two opposing branches that are swept in the direction of the main flow. 
JUNCTION_CROSS_SWEEP: Branch fitting with two swept opposing branches at right angles to the main flow. 
JUNCTION_TEE_SQUARE: Branch fitting in which the branch is at an angle of 90 degrees to the main pipe. 
JUNCTION_TEE_SWEEP: Branch fitting in which the branch is curved through 90 degrees to join a main pipe tangentially. 
JUNCTION_TEE_TWINBEND: Symmetrical pipe fitting in which two short radius bends curve through 90 degree to form a single pipe. 
+I1JUNCTION_TEE_TWINELBOW: Symmetrical pipe fitting in which two elbows curve through 90 degree to form a single pipe. 
JUNCTION_TEE_Y: Branch fitting in the shape of a letter Y. 
OBSTRUCTION_CAP: Device fixed onto the end of a pipe or pipe fitting to close it. 
OBSTRUCTION_PLUG: Device fixed into the end of a pipe or pipe fitting to close it. 
OTHER: Other fitting subtype.
NOTDEFINED: The fitting subtype is not defined.

name: Material Thickness
definition: The thickness of the duct fitting material.

name: Unit Weight
definition: Weight per unit length.

name: Pressure Range
definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

name: Nominal Diameter Or Width
definition: The nominal diameter or width of the duct segment. If the list contains only one value, then this nominal diameter or width applies to all ports. For more than value in the list, the nominal diameter or width value applies to the port that corresponds to the list index.

name: End Style Treatment
definition:
The end-style treatment of the pipe segment as made available from the manufacturer. If the list contains only one value, then this end-style applies to all ports. For more than one value in the list, the end-style value applies to the port that corresponds to the list index.The following suggested items should be utilized whenever possible for correlation with port enumerations:
FLANGED: Flanged. 
GROOVED: Grooved. 
THREADED: Threaded. 
NONE: No end-style has been applied.
NOTDEFINED: Undefined end-style type.

name: Fluid Flow Leakage
definition: Volumetric leakage flow rate.

name: Longitudinal Seam
definition: The type of seam to be used along the longitudinal axis of the duct segment.

name: Length
definition: Length of the pipe segment.

name: Reinforcement
definition: The type of reinforcement, if any, used for the duct segment.

name: Reinforcement Spacing
definition: The spacing between reinforcing elements.

name: Hydraulic Diameter
definition: Hydraulic diameter

name: Working Pressure Range
definition: Allowable minimum and maximum  working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

name: Has Exterior Insulation
definition: TRUE if the silencer has exterior insulation. FALSE if it does not.

name: Voltage
definition: Operating voltage.

name: Real Power
definition: Real power.

name: Reactive Power
definition: Reactive power.

name: Apparent Power
definition: Apparent power.

name: Power Factor
definition: Power factor.

name: Current
definition: Current.

name: Temperature
definition: Operating steam temperature.

name: Pressure
definition: Operating steam pressure.

name: Flowrate
definition: The actual operational fluid flowrate.

name: Quality
definition: Steam quality.

name: Water Sump Temperature
definition: Water sump temperature.

name: Effectiveness
definition: Ratio of the real heat transfer rate to the maximum possible heat transfer rate.

name: Effectiveness Table
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary air flow rate.

name: Water Press Drop Curve
definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

name: Heat Exchange Area
definition: Heat exchange area.

name: Heat Exchanger Media Materials
definition: Heat exchanger media material.

name: Refrigrerant Fouling Resistance
definition: Fouling resistance on the refrigerant side.

name: Evaporating Temperature
definition: Refrigerant evaporating temperature.

name: Compressor Evaporator Heat Gain
definition: Heat gain between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

name: Compressor Evaporator Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

name: Evaporator Mean Void Fraction
definition: Mean void fraction in evaporator.

name: Evaporator Medium Type
definition:
ColdLiquid: Evaporator is using liquid type of fluid to exchange heat with refrigerant.
ColdAir: Evaporator is using air to exchange heat with refrigerant.

name: Evaporator Coolant
definition: The fluid used for the coolant in the evaporator.

name: Fan Rotation Speed
definition: Fan rotation speed.

name: Wheel Tip Speed
definition: Fan blade tip speed, typically defined as the linear speed of the tip of the fan blade furthest from the shaft.

name: Fan Efficiency
definition: Fan mechanical efficiency.

name: Overall Efficiency
definition: The pump and motor overall operational efficiency.

name: Fan Power Rate
definition: Fan power consumption.

name: Shaft Power Rate
definition: Fan shaft power.

name: Pressure Curve
definition: Pressure rise = f (flow rate).

name: Efficiency Curve
definition: Fan efficiency =f (flow rate).

name: Discharge Velocity
definition: The speed at which air discharges from the fan through the fan housing discharge opening.

name: Discharge Pressure Loss
definition: Fan discharge pressure loss associated with the discharge arrangement.

name: Drive Power Loss
definition: Fan drive power losses associated with the type of connection between the motor and the fan wheel.

name: Motor Drive Type
definition:
Motor drive type:
DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive. 
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive. 
COUPLING: Coupling. 
OTHER: Other type of motor drive. 
NOTKNOWN: Unknown motor drive type.
UNSET: Unspecified motor drive type.

name: Capacity Control Type
definition:
InletVane: Control by adjusting inlet vane
VariableSpeedDrive: Control by variable speed drive 
BladePitchAngle: Control by adjusting blade pitch angle
TwoSpeed: Control by switch between high and low speed
DischargeDamper: Control by modulating discharge damper

name: Wheel Material
definition: The material used to construct the fan wheel.

name: Housing Material
definition: The material used to construct the fan housing.

name: Nominal Total Pressure
definition: Nominal total pressure rise across the fan.

name: Nominal Static Pressure
definition: The static pressure within the air stream that the fan must overcome to insure designed circulation of air

name: Nominal Rotation Speed
definition: Pump rotational speed under nominal conditions.

name: Nominal Power Rate
definition: Nominal fan power rate.

name: Operational Criteria
definition: Time of operation at maximum operational ambient air temperature.

name: Maximum Design Temperature
definition: Maximum design operational temperature.

name: Smoke Control Flowrate
definition: Flowrate of fan while operating as a part of the smoke control system.

name: Counted Efficiency
definition: Filter efficiency based the particle counts concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

name: Weighted Efficiency
definition: Filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

name: Particle Mass Holding
definition: Mass of particle holding in the filter.

name: Air Particle Filter Type
definition:
A panel dry type extended surface filter is a dry-type air filter with random fiber mats or blankets in the forms of pockets, V-shaped or radial pleats, and include the following:
CoarseFilter: Filter with a efficiency lower than 30% for atmosphere dust-spot.
CoarseMetalScreen: Filter made of metal screen.
CoarseCellFoams: Filter made of cell foams.
CoarseSpunGlass: Filter made of spun glass.
MediumFilter: Filter with an efficiency between 30-98% for atmosphere dust-spot.
MediumElectretFilter: Filter with fine electret synthetic fibers.
MediumNaturalFiberFilter: Filter with natural fibers.
HEPAFilter: High efficiency particulate air filter.
ULPAFilter: Ultra low penetration air filter.
MembraneFilters: Filter made of membrane for certain pore diameters in flat sheet and pleated form.
A renewable media with a moving curtain viscous filter are random-fiber media coated with viscous substance in roll form or curtain where fresh media is fed across the face of the filter and the dirty media is rewound onto a roll at the bottom or to into a reservoir:
RollForm: Viscous filter used in roll form.
AdhesiveReservoir: Viscous filter used in moving curtain form.
A renewable moving curtain dry media filter is a random-fiber dry media of relatively high porosity used in moving-curtain(roll) filters.
An electrical filter uses electrostatic precipitation to remove and collect particulate contaminants.

name: Separation Type
definition: Air particulate filter media separation type.

name: Dust Holding Capacity
definition: Maximum filter dust holding capacity.

name: Face Surface Area
definition: Face area of filter frame.

name: Media Extended Area
definition: Total extended media area.

name: Nominal Counted Efficiency
definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle count concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

name: Nominal Weighted Efficiency
definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

name: Pressure Drop Curve
definition: Under certain dust holding weight, DelPressure = f (fluidflowRate)

name: Counted Efficiency Curve
definition: Counted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

name: Weighted Efficiency Curve
definition: Weighted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

name: Initial Resistance
definition: Initial new filter fluid resistance (i.e., pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter is new per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

name: Final Resistance
definition: Filter fluid resistance when replacement is required (i.e., Pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter needs replacement per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

name: Flow Rate Range
definition: Allowable range of volume of fluid being pumped against the resistance specified.

name: Nominal Filter Face Velocity
definition: Filter face velocity.

name: Nominal Media Surface Velocity
definition: Average fluid velocity at the media surface.

name: Nominal Pressure Drop
definition: Total pressure drop across the filter.

name: Nominal Flowrate
definition: Nominal fluid flow rate through the filter.

name: Nominal Particle Geometric Mean Diameter
definition: Particle geometric mean diameter associated with nominal efficiency.

name: Nominal Particle Geometric Standard Deviation
definition: Particle geometric standard deviation associated with nominal efficiency.

name: Read Out Type
definition: Indication of the form that readout from the meter takes. In the case of a dial read out, this may comprise multiple dials that give a cumulative reading and/or a mechanical odometer.

name: Remote Reading
definition: Indicates whether the meter has a connection for remote reading through connection of a communication device (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE).

name: Gas Type
definition: Defines the types of gas that may be specified.

name: Maximum Flow Rate
definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

name: Maximum Pressure Loss
definition: Pressure loss expected across the meter under conditions of maximum flow.

name: Type
definition:
Defines the types of tank that may be specified where: 

BreakPressure =	 Tank that breaks the hydraulic pressure in a distribution system
Expansion =	 Tank, connected to the primary circuit of a hot water system that accommodates increase in volume of the water when heated
FeedAndExpansion =	 Tank that supplies cold water to a hot water system and also accommodates increase in volume of the water when heated
GasStorage_Butane =	 Main tank to which commercial butane is delivered and from which it is supplied to a gas distribution system.
GasStorage_LPG =	 Main tank to which liquefied petroleum gas is delivered and from which it is supplied to a gas distribution system.
GasStorage_Propane =	 Main tank to which commercial propane is delivered and from which it is supplied to a gas distribution system.
OilService =	 Secondary tank from which oil fuel is fed to a single oil fuel burning appliance
OilStorage =	 Main tank to which oil fuel is delivered and from which it is supplied to an oil fuel burning appliance or oil service tank.
PressureVessel =  Tank that stores fluid under pressure.
WaterStorage_General =	 Tank that stores water sufficient to meet general requirements for a designated period of time and supplies it to points of outlet
WaterStorage_Potable =	 Tank that stores water sufficient to meet potable water requirements for a designated period of time and supplies it to points of outlet
WaterStorage_Process =	 Tank that stores water sufficient to meet process and/or production requirements for a designated period of time and supplies it to points of outlet
WaterStorage_CoolingTowerMakeup =	 Tank that stores water sufficient to meet cooling tower make up water requirements for a designated period of time and supplies it to points of outlet

name: Backflow Preventer Type
definition: Identifies the type of backflow preventer installed to prevent the backflow of contaminated or polluted water from an irrigation/reticulation system to a potable water supply.

name: Gas Flow Rate
definition: The volumetric flowrate of gas to the gas terminal.

name: Gas Flow Rate Range
definition: Gas volumetric flowrate within which the gas  terminal is designed to operate.

name: Gas Appliance Type
definition: Selection of the type of gas appliance from the enumerated list of types.

name: Flue Type
definition:
Defines the types of flue that may be specified for connection to gas appliances where:

BalancedFlue =	Room sealed appliance that has its inlet for combustion air and its outlet for products of combustion in adjacent external positions, disposed so that wind effects are substantially balanced between them.
Flued =	Gas burning appliance designed for connection to a flue system
Flueless =	Gas burning appliance designed for use without connection to a flue system
OpenFlued =	Gas burning appliance designed to be connected to an open flue system, combustion air being drawn from a room or internal space in which the gas burning appliance is installed
RoomSealed =	Gas burning appliance that has its combustion system, including air inlet and products outlet, isolated from a room or internal space in which the gas burning appliance is installed

name: Gas Burner Type
definition: Selection of the type of gas burner from the enumerated list of types

name: Arrangement
definition:
Defines the fan and motor drive arrangement as defined by AMCA:
ARRANGEMENT1: Arrangement 1. 
ARRANGEMENT2: Arrangement 2. 
ARRANGEMENT3: Arrangement 3. 
ARRANGEMENT4: Arrangement 4. 
ARRANGEMENT7: Arrangement 7. 
ARRANGEMENT8: Arrangement 8. 
ARRANGEMENT9: Arrangement 9. 
ARRANGEMENT10: Arrangement 10. 
OTHER: Other type of fan drive arrangement.

name: Shell Material
definition: Material used to construct the shell of the heat exchanger.

name: Number Of Plates
definition: Number of plates used by the plate heat exchanger.

name: Saturation Efficiency
definition: Saturation efficiency: Ratio of leaving air absolute humidity to the maximum absolute humidity.

name: Saturation Efficiency Curve
definition: Saturation efficiency as a function of the air flow rate.

name: Application
definition:
Humidifier application.
Fixed: Humidifier installed in a ducted flow distribution system.
Portable: Humidifier is not installed in a ducted flow distribution system.

name: Nominal Moisture Gain
definition: Nominal rate of water vapor added into the airstream.

name: Internal Control
definition: Internal modulation control.

name: Flange Table
definition: Designation of the standard table to which the flange conforms

name: Flange Standard
definition: Designation of the standard describing the flange table

name: Bore Size
definition: The nominal bore of the pipe flange

name: Flange Diameter
definition: Overall diameter of the flange

name: Flange Thickness
definition: Thickness of the material from which the pipe bend is constructed

name: Number Of Boltholes
definition: Number of boltholes in the flange

name: Bolt Size
definition: Size of the bolts securing the flange

name: Bolthole Pitch
definition: Diameter of the circle along which the boltholes are placed

name: Flowrate Leakage
definition: Leakage flowrate versus pressure difference.

name: Nominal Diameter
definition: Nominal diameter or width of the tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Inner Diameter
definition: The actual inner diameter of the pipe. Refer to NominalDiameter for comments about interpretation of multiple items in the list.

name: Outer Diameter
definition: The actual outer diameter of the pipe. Refer to NominalDiameter for comments about interpretation of multiple items in the list.

name: Fitting Loss Factor
definition: A factor that determines the pressure loss due to friction through the fitting.

name: Slope
definition:
Sloping angle of the object  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees). 
Actual maximum slope for the passageway according to the current design.
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Flow Rating
definition: Actual flow capacity for the gutter. Value of 0.00 means this value has not been set.

name: Tilt Angle
definition: The angle of tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

name: Azimuth
definition: Azimuth of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: North = 0' and measurement is done clockwise (I.e. east = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Pressure Rise
definition: The developed pressure.

name: Rotation Speed
definition: Pump rotational speed.

name: Power
definition: The actual power consumption of the pump.

name: Flow Resistance Range
definition: Allowable range of frictional resistance against which the fluid is being pumped

name: Impeller Material
definition: Material from which the impeller of the pump is constructed. In the case of a positive displacement pump, the piston acts as the impeller

name: Impeller Seal Material
definition: Material from which the impeller shaft seal of the pump is constructed.

name: Net Positive Suction Head
definition: Minimum liquid pressure at the pump inlet to prevent cavitation.

name: Fraction Radiant Heat Transfer
definition: Fraction of the total heat transfer rate as the radiant heat transfer.

name: Fraction Convective Heat Transfer
definition: Fraction of the total heat transfer rate as the convective heat transfer.

name: Surface Temperature
definition: Average surface temperature of the component.

name: Space Air Temperature
definition: Dry bulb temperature in the space.

name: Space Mean Radiant Temperature
definition: Mean radiant temperature in the space.

name: Auxiliary Energy Source Consumption
definition: Auxiliary energy source consumption.

name: Output Capacity Curve
definition: Partial output capacity curve (as a function of water temperature); Q = f (Twater).

name: Air Resistance Curve
definition: Air resistance curve (w/ fan only); Pressure = f ( flow rate).

name: Exponent
definition: Characteristic exponent, slope of log(heat output) vs log (surface temperature minus environmental temperature).

name: Heat Output Rate
definition: Overall heat transfer rate.

name: Temperature Classification
definition:
Enumeration defining the temperature classification of the space heater surface temperature.
low temperature - surface temperature is relatively low, usually heated by hot water or electricity.
high temperature - surface temperature is relatively high, usually heated by gas or steam.

name: Heating Source
definition: Enumeration defining the heating source used by the space heater.

name: Body Mass
definition: Overall body mass of the heater.

name: Thermal Mass Heat Capacity
definition: Product of component mass and specific heat

name: Output Capacity
definition: Total nominal heat output as listed by the manufacturer.

name: Thermal Efficiency
definition: Overall Thermal Efficiency is defined as gross energy output of the heat transfer device divided by the energy input.

name: Tubing Length
definition: Water tube length inside the component.

name: Water Content
definition: Weight of water content within the heater.

name: Cooling Air Flow Rate
definition: Cooling air flow rate in the space.

name: Heating Air Flow Rate
definition: Heating air flow rate in the space.

name: Ventilation Air Flow Rate
definition: Ventilation air flow rate in the space.

name: Exhaust Air Flow Rate
definition: Exhaust air flow rate in the space.

name: Space Temperature
definition: Temperature of the space.

name: Space Relative Humidity
definition: The relative humidity of the space.

name: Access Type
definition:
Defines the types of access (or cover) to a tank that may be specified.

Note that covers are generally specified for rectangular tanks. For cylindrical tanks, access will normally be via a manhole.

name: Nominal Length Or Diameter
definition: The nominal length or, in the case of a vertical cylindrical tank, the nominal diameter of the tank

name: Nominal Depth
definition: The nominal depth of the furniture of this type. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Effective Capacity
definition: The effective or actual volumetric capacity of the tank.

name: Operating Weight
definition: Operating weight of the tank including all of its contents.

name: Charge Pressure
definition: Nominal or design operating pressure of the tank.

name: Pressure Regulator Setting
definition: Pressure that is automatically maintained in the tank.

name: Relief Valve Setting
definition: Pressure at which the relief valve activates.

name: Pattern Type
definition: Defines the types of pattern (or shape of a tank that may be specified.

name: End Shape Type
definition: Defines the types of end shapes that can be used for preformed tanks. The convention for reading these enumerated values is that for a vertical cylinder, the first value is the base and the second is the top; for a horizontal cylinder, the order of reading should be left to right. For a speherical tank, the value UNSET should be used.

name: First Curvature Radius
definition: FirstCurvatureRadius should be defined as the base or left side radius of curvature value.

name: Second Curvature Radius
definition: SecondCurvatureRadius should be defined as the top or right side radius of curvature value.

name: Number Of Sections
definition: Number of vertical sections, measured in the direction of flow.

name: Section Length
definition: The length of a section used in the construction of the tank

name: Section Width
definition: The width of a section used in the construction of the tank.

name: Number Of Rows
definition: Number of tube rows in the tube bundle assembly.

name: Staggered Row Spacing
definition: Staggered tube row spacing.

name: In Line Row Spacing
definition: In-line tube row spacing.

name: Number Of Circuits
definition: Number of parallel fluid tube circuits.

name: Fouling Factor
definition: Fouling factor of the tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Thermal Conductivity
definition: The thermal conductivity of the fin.

name: Volume
definition: Total volume of fluid in the tubes and their headers.

name: Outside Diameter
definition: Actual outside diameter of the tube in the tube bundle.

name: Inside Diameter
definition: Actual inner diameter of the tube in the tube bundle.

name: Horizontal Spacing
definition: Horizontal spacing between tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Vertical Spacing
definition: Vertical spacing between tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Has Turbulator
definition: TRUE if the tube has a turbulator, FALSE if it does not.

name: Spacing
definition: Distance between fins on a tube in the tube bundle.

name: Thickness
definition: Thickness of the fin.

name: Height
definition:
Height of the object. It is the upper hight of the railing above the floor or stair.
