The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Diameter
definition:
Diameter of the object. It is the diameter of the handrail of the railing.
The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Here the diameter of the hand or guardrail within the railing.

name: Fin Corrugated Type
definition: Description of a fin corrugated type.

name: Has Coating
definition: TRUE if the fin has a coating, FALSE if it does not.

name: Sensible Cooling Capacity
definition: Sensible cooling capacity of the PackagedACUnit per ARI Standards 210/240, 270, 275, 360, 340 and 365.

name: Latent Cooling Capacity
definition: Latent cooling capacity of the PackagedACUnit per ARI Standards 210/240, 270, 275, 360, 340 and 365.

name: Cooling Efficiency
definition: Coefficient of Performance: Ratio of cooling energy output to energy input under full load operating conditions per ARI Standards 210/240, 270, 275, 360, 340 and 365.

name: Heating Capacity
definition: Heating capacity of the PackagedACUnit per ARI Standards 210/240, 270, 275, 360, 340 and 365 for heat pumps, AFUE for fuel burning and NEMA for electric heat.

name: Heating Efficiency
definition: Heating efficiency of the PackagedACUnit under full load heating conditions per ARI Standards 210/240, 270, 275, 360, 340 and 365 for heat pumps, AFUE for fuel burning and NEMA for electric heat.

name: Condenser Flowrate
definition: Flow rate of fluid through the condenser per manufacturer's listing (if available)

name: Condenser Entering Temperature
definition: Temperature of fluid entering condenser per manufacturer's listing (if available)

name: Condenser Leaving Temperature
definition: Termperature of fluid leaving condenser per manufacturer's listing (if available)

name: Outside Air Flowrate
definition: Flow rate of outside air entering the PackagedACUnit per the manufacturer's listing (if available)

name: Air Handler Construction
definition: Enumeration defining how the air handler might be fabricated.

name: Air Handler Fan Coil Arrangement
definition: Enumeration defining the arrangement of the supply air fan and the cooling coil.

name: Dual Deck
definition: Does the AirHandler have a dual deck? TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Percentage Open
definition: The ratio between the amount that the valve is open to the full open position of the valve.

name: Measured Flow Rate
definition: The rate of flow of a fluid measured across the valve.

name: Measured Pressure Drop
definition: The actual pressure drop in the fluid measured across the valve.

name: Is Automatic
definition: Indication of whether the valve is automatically operated (TRUE) or manually operated (FALSE)

name: Valve Pattern
definition:
The configuration of the ports of a valve according to either the linear route taken by a fluid flowing through the valve or by the number of ports where:

SINGLEPORT = Valve that has a single entry port from the system that it serves, the exit port being to the surrounding environment.
ANGLED_2_PORT = Valve in which the direction of flow is changed through 90 degrees
STRAIGHT_2_PORT = Valve in which the flow is straight through
STRAIGHT_3_PORT = Valve with three separate ports
CROSSOVER_4_PORT = Valve with 4 separate ports

name: Valve Operation
definition:
The method of valve operation where:

DROPWEIGHT = A valve that is closed by the action of a weighted lever being released, the weight normally being prevented from dropping by being held by a wire, the closure normally being made by the action of heat on a fusible link in the wire
FLOAT = A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a float that rises and falls with water level. The float may be a ball attached to a lever or other mechanism
HYDRAULIC = A valve that is opened and closed by hydraulic actuation
LEVER = A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a lever rotating the gate within the valve.
LOCKSHIELD = A valve that requires the use of a special lockshield key for opening and closing, the operating mechanism being protected by a shroud during normal operation.
MOTORIZED = A valve that is opened and closed by the action of an electric motor on an actuator
PNEUMATIC = A valve that is opened and closed by pneumatic actuation
SOLENOID = A valve that is normally held open by a magnetic field in a coil acting on the gate but that is closed immediately if the electrical current generating the magnetic field is removed. 
SPRING = A valve that is normally held in position by the pressure of a spring on a plate but that may be caused to open if the pressure of the fluid is sufficient to overcome the spring pressure. 
THERMOSTATIC = A valve in which the ports are opened or closed to maintain a required predetermined temperature.
WHEEL = A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a wheel moving the gate within the valve.

name: Valve Mechanism
definition:
The mechanism by which the valve function is achieved where:

BALL Valve that has a ported ball that can be turned relative to the body seat ports
BUTTERFLY Valve in which a streamlined disc pivots about a diametric axis
CONFIGUREDGATE Screwdown valve in which the closing gate is shaped in a configured manner to have a more precise control of pressure and flow change across the valve.
GLAND Valve with a tapered seating, in which a rotatable plug is retained by means of a gland and gland packing
GLOBE Screwdown valve that has a spherical body
LUBRICATEDPLUG Plug valve in which a lubricant is injected under pressure between the plug face and the body
NEEDLE Valve for regulating the flow in or from a pipe, in which a slender cone moves along the axis of flow to close against a fixed conical seat
PARALLELSLIDE Screwdown valve that has a machined plate that slides in formed grooves to form a seal
PLUG Valve that has a ported plug that can be turned relative to the body seat ports
WEDGEGATE Screwdown valve that has a wedge shaped plate fitting into tapered guides to form a seal

name: Size
definition: The size of the connection to the valve (or to each connection for faucets, mixing valves, etc.)

name: Body Material
definition: The primary material used to construct the object

name: Operating Mechanism Material
definition: Material from which the operating mechanism (gate, globe, plug, needle, clack etc.) of the valve is constructed

name: Test Pressure
definition: The maximum pressure to which the valve has been subjected under test

name: Flow Coefficient
definition: Flow coefficient (the quantity of fluid that passes through a fully open valve at unit pressure drop), typically expressed as the Kv or Cv value for the valve.

name: Has Hose Union
definition: Indicates whether the gas tap is fitted with a hose union connection (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Faucet Type
definition:
Defines the range of faucet types that may be specified where:

Bib =	 Faucet with a horizontal inlet and a nozzle that discharges downwards.
Globe =	 Faucet fitted through the end of a bath, with a horizontal inlet, a partially spherical body and a vertical nozzle.
Diverter =	Combination faucet assembly with a valve to enable the flow of mixed water to be transferred to a showerhead.
DividedFlowCombination =	 Combination faucet assembly in which hot and cold water are kept separate until emerging from a common nozzle
Pillar =	 Faucet that has a vertical inlet and a nozzle that discharges downwards
SingleOutletCombination =	 Combination faucet assembly in which hot and cold water mix before emerging from a common nozzle
Spray =	 Faucet with a spray outlet
SprayMixing =	 Spray faucet connected to hot and cold water supplies that delivers water at a temperature determined during use.

name: Faucet Operation
definition:
Defines the range of ways in which a faucet can be operated that may be specified where:

CeramicDisc =	 Quick action faucet with a ceramic seal to open or close the orifice
LeverHandle =	 Quick action faucet that is operated by a lever handle
NonConcussiveSelfClosing =	 Self closing faucet that does not induce surge pressure
QuarterTurn =	 Quick action faucet that can be fully opened or shut by turning the operating mechanism through 90 degrees.
QuickAction =	 Faucet that can be opened or closed fully with a single small movement of the operating mechanism
ScrewDown =	 Faucet in which a plate or disc is moved, by the rotation of a screwed spindle, to close or open the orifice.
SelfClosing =	 Faucet that is opened by pressure of the top of an operating spindle and is closed under the action of a spring or weight when the pressure is released
TimedSelfClosing = 	Self closing faucet that discharges for a predetermined period of time

name: Faucet Function
definition: Defines the operating temperature of a faucet that may be specified.

name: Finish
definition:
Finish selection for this object.
Here specification of the surface finish for informational purposes

name: Faucet Top Description
definition: Description of the operating mechanism/top of the faucet

name: Flushing Rate
definition: The predetermined quantity of water to be flushed

name: Has Integral Shut Off Device
definition: Indication of whether the flushing valve has an integral shut off device fitted (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE)

name: Is High Pressure
definition: Indication of whether the flushing valve is suitable for use on a high pressure water main (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE)

name: Is Normally Open
definition: If TRUE, the valve is normally open. If FALSE is is normally closed.

name: Isolating Purpose
definition: Defines the purpose for which the isolating valve is used since the way in which the valve is identified as an isolating valve may be in the context of its use. Note that unless there is a contextual name for the isolating valve (as in the case of a Landing Valve on a rising fire main), then the value assigned shoulkd be UNSET

name: Mixer Control
definition: Defines the form of control of the mixing valve.

name: Outlet Connection Size
definition: Size of the outlet connection from the object

name: Upstream Pressure
definition: The operating pressure of the fluid upstream of the pressure reducing valve

name: Downstream Pressure
definition: The operating pressure of the fluid downstream of the pressure reducing valve

name: Relief Pressure
definition: The pressure at which the spring or weight in the valve is set to discharge fluid

name: Vibration Transmissibility
definition: The vibration transmissibility percentage.

name: Isolator Static Deflection
definition: Static deflection of the vibration isolator.

name: Isolator Compressibility
definition: The compressibility of the vibration isolator.

name: Maximum Supported Weight
definition: The maximum weight that can be carried by the vibration isolator.

name: Number Of Actors
definition: The number of actors that are to be dealt with together in the population.

name: Category
definition: Category of space usage or utilization of the area. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

name: Skill Level
definition: Skill level exhibited by the actor and which indicates an extent of their capability to perform actions on the artefacts upon which they can act.

name: Name
definition: The name of the air side system

name: Group Name
definition: Name of grouping of topics.

name: Classification
definition: A reference to a classification of the topic

name: Demand Value
definition: Value of the subject matter as determined using an agreed scale for what is required.

name: Demand Threshold Value
definition: Value of the subject matter above or below which a special significance is attached.

name: Demand Importance Value
definition: Importance of the topic relative to the importance of other topics.

name: Supply Evaluation Value
definition: Value of the subject matter as determined using an agreed scale for what is provided, or capable of being provided.

name: Gap Value
definition: Difference determined between the topic demand value and the topic supply evaluation value.

name: Gap Value Weighted
definition: Difference determined between the topic demand value and the topic supply evaluation value, weighted for topic demand importance value.

name: Construction Mode
definition: The type of construction action the project deals with, e.g. new construction, renovation, refurbishment, etc.

name: Building Permit Id
definition: The building permit identifier for the written authorization required by building authorities before construction on a specific project can begin.

name: Gross Area Planned
definition: Total planned gross area for the space. Used for programming the space.

name: Is Design Point
definition: Indicates whether an instance of IfcDistributionPort is to act as the design point for sprinkler hydraulic calculation (set TRUE) or not (either set FALSE or assumed to be FALSE where an instance of the property set is not assigned to an instance of IfcDistributionPort).

name: Area Drained
definition: The area measure enclosed within the catchment

name: Internal Width
definition: The internal width of the culvert

name: Clear Depth
definition: The depth of the formed space in the duct.

name: Invert Level
definition: Level of the lowest part of the cross section. (BS6100 250 8001)

name: Width
definition: The width of the trench.

name: Breeching Inlet Type
definition: Defines the type of breeching inlet.

name: Inlet Diameter
definition: The inlet diameter of the breeching inlet.

name: Outlet Diameter
definition: The outlet diameter of the breeching inlet.

name: Coupling Type
definition: Defines the type coupling on the inlet of the breeching inlet.

name: Has Caps
definition: Does the inlet connection have protective caps.

name: Fire Hydrant Type
definition:
Defines the range of hydrant types from which the required type can be selected where:

DryBarrel =	 A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted below ground and that may be used where the possibility of water freezing is a consideration.
WetBarrel =	 A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted above ground and that may be used where there is no possibility of water freezing.

name: Pumper Connection Size
definition: The size of a connection to which a fire hose may be connected that is then linked to a pumping unit.

name: Number Of Hose Connections
definition: The number of hose connections on the hydrant (excluding the pumper connection)

name: Hose Connection Size
definition: The size of connections to which a hose may be connected (other than that to be linked to a pumping unit).

name: Discharge Flow Rate
definition: The volumetric rate of fluid discharge.

name: Flow Class
definition: Alphanumeric indication of the flow class of a hydrant (may be used in connection with or instead of the FlowRate property)

name: Water Is Potable
definition: Indication of whether the water flow from the hydrant is potable (set TRUE) or non potable (set FALSE)

name: Body Color
definition:
Color of the body of the hydrant.

Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colors that may be required for hydrant bodies in particular circumstances.

name: Cap Color
definition:
Color of the caps of the hydrant.

Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colors that may be required for hydrant caps in particular circumstances.

name: Hose Reel Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose arrangement from which the type required may be set.

name: Hose Reel Mounting Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose reel mounting from which the type required may be set.

name: Inlet Connection Size
definition:
Size of the inlet connection(s), where used, of the inlet connections.

Note that all inlet connections are assumed to be the same size.

name: Hose Diameter
definition: Notional diameter (bore) of the hose.

name: Hose Length
definition: Notional length of the hose fitted to the hose reel when fully extended.

name: Hose Nozzle Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of nozzle (in terms of spray pattern) fitted to the end of the hose from which the type required may be set.

name: Class Of Service
definition: A classification of usage of the hose reel that may be applied.

name: Classification Authority
definition: The name of the authority that applies the classification of service to the hose reel (e.g. NFPA/FEMA)

name: Sprinkler Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of sprinkler  from which the type required may be set.

name: Activation
definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler activation from which that required may be set.

name: Response
definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler response from which that required may be set.

name: Activation Temperature
definition: The temperature at which the object is designed to activate.

name: Has Deflector
definition: Indication of whether the sprinkler has a deflector (baffle) fitted to diffuse the discharge on activation (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Bulb Liquid Color
definition: The color of the liquid in the bulb for a bulb activated sprinkler. Note that the liquid color varies according to the activation temperature requirement of the sprinkler head. Note also that this property does not need to be asserted for quick response activated sprinklers.

name: Residual Flowing Pressure
definition: The residual flowing pressure in the pipeline at which the discharge flow rate is determined.

name: Discharge Coefficient
definition: The coefficient of flow at the sprinkler

name: Deflector Material
definition: The material used to construct the deflector plate.

name: Bath Type
definition:
The property enumeration defines the types of bath that may be specified within the property set where:

Domestic =	Bath, for one person at a time, into which the whole body can be easily immersed.
DomesticCorner =	Bath, for one person at a time, into which the whole body can be easily immersed and in which the immersion trough is at an angle.
Foot =	Shallow bath for washing the feet.
Jacuzzi =	Whirlpool bath for more than one person
Plunge =	Bath, usually for more than one person at a time, into which the whole body can be easily immersed.
Sitz =	Bath in which a bather sits as in a chair.
Treatment =	Bath used for hydrotherapy purposes.
Whirlpool =	Bath in which an integrated device agitates the water by pumped circulation or induction of water and/or air.

name: Color
definition:
The color of the pipe segment.

Note: This is typically used only for plastic pipe segments. However, it may be used for any pipe segments with a painted surface which is not otherwise specified as a covering.

name: Drain Size
definition: The size of the drain outlet connection from the object.

name: Has Grab Handles
definition: Indicates whether the bath is fitted with handles that provide assistance to a bather in entering or leaving the bath

name: Bidet Mounting
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_SanitaryMountingEnum defines the forms of mounting or fixing of the sanitary terminal that may be specified within property sets used to define sanitary terminals (WC’s, basins, sinks, etc.) where:-

BackToWall =	A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal =	A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop =	A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung =	A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor

name: Spillover Level
definition: The level at which water spills out of the terminal.

name: Cistern Height
definition: Enumeration that identifies the height of the cistern or, if set to 'None' if the urinal has no cistern and is flushed using mains or high pressure water through a flushing valve.

name: Cistern Capacity
definition: Volumetric capacity of the cistern

name: Is Single Flush
definition: Indicates whether the cistern is single flush = TRUE (i.e. the same amount of water is used for each and every flush) or dual flush = FALSE (i.e. the amount of water used for a flush may be selected by the user to be high or low depending on the waste material to be removed)

name: Flush Type
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_FlushTypeEnum defines the types of flushing mechanism that may be specified for cisterns and sanitary terminals where:-

Lever =	Flushing is achieved by twisting a lever that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Pull =	Flushing is achieved by pulling a handle or knob vertically upwards that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Push =	Flushing is achieved by pushing a button or plate that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Sensor = Flush is activated through an automatic sensing mechanism.

name: Flush Rate
definition: The minimum and maximum volume of water used at each flush. Where a single flush is used, the value of upper bound and lower bound should be equal. For a dual flush toilet, the lower bound should be used for the lesser flush rate and the upper bound for the greater flush rate. Where flush is achieved using mains pressure water through a flush valve, the value of upper and lower bound should be equal and should be the same as the flush rate property of the flush valve (see relevant valve property set). Alternatively, in this case, do not assert the flush rate property; refer to the flush rate of the flush valve.

name: Is Automatic Flush
definition: Boolean value that determines if the cistern is flushed automatically either after each use or periodically (TRUE) or whether manual flushing is required (FALSE)

name: Cistern Material
definition: Material from which the object is constructed

name: Cistern Color
definition: Color of the object

name: Fountain Type
definition:
Selection of the type of fountain from the enumerated list of types where:-

DrinkingWater =	Sanitary appliance that provides a low pressure jet of drinking water.
Eyewash =	Waste water appliance, usually installed in work places where there is a risk of injury to eyes by solid particles or dangerous liquids, with which the user can wash the eyes without touching them.

name: Mounting
definition:
Selection of the form of mounting of the fountain from the enumerated list of mountings where:-

BackToWall =	A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal =	A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop =	A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung =	A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor

name: Shower Type
definition:
Selection of the type of shower from the enumerated list of types where:-

Drench = 	Shower that rapidly gives a thorough soaking in an emergency
Individual =	Shower unit that is typically enclosed and is for the use of one person at a time
Tunnel =  	Shower that has a succession of shower heads or spreaders that operate simultaneously along its length

name: Has Tray
definition: Indicates whether the shower has a separate receptacle that catches the water in a shower and directs it to a waste outlet.

name: Shower Head Description
definition: A description of the shower head(s) that emit the spray of water

name: Sink Type
definition:
Selection of the type of sink from the enumerated list of types where:-

Belfast =  	Deep sink that has a plain edge and a weir overflow
.
Bucket = 	Sink at low level, with protected front edge, that facilitates filling and emptying buckets, usually with a hinged grid on which to stand them.
Cleaners =	 Sink, usually fixed at normal height (900mm), with protected front edge.
Combination_Left =	 Sink with integral drainer on left hand side
.
Combination_Right =	 Sink with integral drainer on right hand side
.
Combination_Double = 	Sink with integral drainer on both sides
.
Drip =	 Small sink that catches drips or flow from a faucet
.
Laboratory =	 Sink, of acid resisting material, with a top edge shaped to facilitate fixing to the underside of a desktop
.
London =	 Deep sink that has a plain edge and no overflow
.
Plaster = Sink with sediment receiver to prevent waste plaster passing into drains
.
Pot =	 Large metal sink, with a standing waste, for washing cooking utensils
.
Rinsing =	 Metal sink in which water can be heated and culinary utensils and tableware immersed at high temperature that destroys most harmful bacteria and allows subsequent self drying.
.
Shelf =	 Ceramic sink with an integral back shelf through which water fittings are mounted
.
VegetablePreparation =	Large metal sink, with a standing waste, for washing and preparing vegetables
.

name: Sink Mounting
definition:
Selection of the form of mounting of the sink from the enumerated list of mountings where:-

BackToWall =	A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal =	A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop =	A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung =	A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor

name: Toilet Type
definition:
Enumeration that defines the types of toilet (water closet) arrangements that may be specified where:-

BedPanWasher =	Enclosed soil appliance in which bedpans and urinal bottles are emptied and cleansed
Chemical =	Portable receptacle or soil appliance that receives and retains excrement in either an integral or a separate container, in which it is chemically treated and from which it has to be emptied periodically.
CloseCoupled =	Toilet suite in which a flushing cistern is connected directly to the water closet pan.
LooseCoupled =	Toilet arrangement in which a flushing cistern is connected to the water closet pan through a flushing pipe.
SlopHopper =	Hopper shaped soil appliance with a flushing rim and outlet similar to those of a toilet pan, into which human excrement is emptied for disposal

name: Toilet Pan Type
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_ToiletPanTypeEnum defines the types of toilet pan that may be specified within the property set Pset_Toilet:-

Siphonic =	Toilet pan in which excrement is removed by siphonage induced by the flushing water.
Squat =	Toilet pan with an elongated bowl installed with its top edge at or near floor level, so that the user has to squat.
WashDown =	Toilet pan in which excrement is removed by the momentum of the flushing water.
WashOut =	A washdown toilet pan in which excrement falls first into a shallow water filled bowl.

name: Pan Mounting
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_SanitaryMountingEnum defines the forms of mounting or fixing of the sanitary terminal that may be specified within property sets used to define sanitary terminals (WC’s, basins, sinks, etc.) where:-

BackToWall =	A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal =	A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop =	A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung =	A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor

name: Pan Material
definition: Material from which the object is constructed

name: Pan Color
definition: Color selection for this object

name: Urinal Type
definition:
Selection of the type of urinal from the enumerated list of types where:-

Bowl =	Individual wall mounted urinal
Slab =	Urinal that consists of a slab or sheet fixed to a wall and down which urinal flows into a floor channel
Stall =	Floor mounted urinal that consists of an elliptically shaped sanitary stall fixed to a wall and down which urine flows into a floor channel
Trough =	Wall mounted urinal of elongated rectangular shape on plan, that can be used by more than one person at a time.

name: Urinal Material
definition: Material from which the object is constructed

name: Urinal Color
definition: Color of the urinal

name: Wash Hand Basin Type
definition:
Defines the types of wash hand basin that may be specified where: 
DentalCuspidor = Waste water appliance that receives and flushes away mouth washings
HandRinse = Wall mounted wash hand basin that has an overall width of 500mm or less
Hospital = Wash hand basin that has a smooth easy clean surface without tapholes or overflow slot for use where hygiene is of prime importance. 
Tipup = Wash hand basin mounted on pivots so that it can be emptied by tilting 
Vanity = Wash hand basin for installation into a horizontal surface 
Washfountain = Wash hand basin that is circular, semi-circular or polygonal on plan, at which more than one person can wash at the same time. 
WashingTrough = Wash hand basin of elongated rectangular shape in plan, at which more than one person can wash at the same time.

name: Wash Hand Basin Mounting
definition:
Selection of the form of mounting from the enumerated list of mountings where:-

BackToWall =	A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal =	A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop =	A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung =	A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor

name: Seat Type
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_ToiletSeatTypeEnum defines the types of seat that may be attached to the toilet pan and specified within the property set Pset_Toilet where:-

Extension =	WC seat that is attached at the back, by means of side or top hinges, to a flat piece of material secured to the water closet pan
Inset =	Seat that consists of pads of impervious material fixed to the top of a water closet pan
OpenFrontSeat =	Hinged WC seat shaped like a horseshoe with the gap at the front
RingSeat =	WC seat in the shape of a ring
SelfRaising =	WC seat with balanced weights or springs to raise it when not in use
None =	There is no seat attached to the water closet pan

name: Seat Has Cover
definition: Indicates whether there is a cover associated with the toilet seat

name: Seat Material
definition: Material from which the object is constructed

name: Seat Color
definition: Color of the object

name: Nominal Body Length
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the drain.

name: Nominal Body Width
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the drain.

name: Nominal Body Depth
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis in the local coordinate system of the drain.

name: Is For Sullage Water
definition: Indicates if the purpose of the floor trap is to receive sullage water, or if that is amongst its purposes (= TRUE), or not (= FALSE). Note that if TRUE, it is expected that an upstand or kerb will be placed around the floor trap to prevent the ingress of surface water runoff; the provision of the upstand or kerb is not dealt with in this property set.

name: Trap Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of trap from which the type required may be set.

name: Has Strainer
definition: Indicates whether the gully trap has a strainer (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Inlet Pattern Type
definition:
Identifies the pattern of inlet connections to a trap.

A trap may have 0,1,2,3 or 4 inlet connections and the pattern of their arrangement may vary. The enumeration makes the convention that an outlet is either vertical or is placed at the bottom (south side) of the trap (when viewed in plan). Position 1 is to the left (west), position 2 is to the top (north), position 3 is to the right (east) and position 4 is to the bottom (south).

name: Cover Length
definition: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the drain.

name: Cover Width
definition: The length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the  drain.

name: Cover Material
definition: Material from which the cover or grating is constructed.

name: Nominal Body Material
definition: The material from which the object is constructed.

name: Body Depth
definition: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the object, of the body of the object.

name: Strainer Material
definition: Material from which the strainer is constructed.

name: Strainer Diameter
definition: Diameter, measured in plan view, of the strainer basket.

name: Strainer Depth
definition: Depth, measured in elevation view, of the strainer basket.

name: Nominal Sump Length
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the sump.

name: Nominal Sump Width
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the sump.

name: Nominal Sump Depth
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis in the local coordinate system of the sump.

name: Sump Material
definition: The primary material used to construct the object

name: Gully Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of gully from which the type required may be set.

name: Back Inlet Pattern Type
definition:
Identifies the pattern of inlet connections to a gully trap.

A gulley trap may have 0,1,2,3 or 4 inlet connections and the pattern of their arrangement may vary. The enumeration makes the convention that an outlet is either vertical or is placed at the bottom (south side) of the gully trap (when viewed in plan). Position 1 is to the left (west), position 2 is to the top (north), position 3 is to the right (east) and position 4 is to the bottom (south).

name: Ventilating Pipe Size
definition: Size of the ventilating pipe(s)

name: Drain Connection Size
definition: Size of the drain connection inlet to the waste disposal unit.

name: Waste Trap Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of trap from which the type required may be set.

name: Building ID
definition: A unique identifier assigned to a building. A temporary identifier is initially assigned at the time of making a planning application. This temporary identifier is changed to a permanent identifier when the building is registered into a statutory buildings and properties database.

name: Is Permanent ID
definition: Indicates whether the identity assigned to a building is permanent (= TRUE) or temporary (=FALSE)

name: Main Fire Use
definition: Main fire use for the space which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

name: Ancillary Fire Use
definition: Ancillary fire use for the space which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

name: Sprinkler Protection
definition: Indication whether the space is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Sprinkler Protection Automatic
definition:
Indication whether the space has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

name: Gross Planned Area
definition: Total planned area for the space. Used for programming the space.

name: Number Of Storeys
definition: Captures the number of storeys within a building for those cases where the IfcBuildingStorey entity is not used. Note that if IfcBuilingStorey is asserted and the number of storeys in a building can be determined from it, then this approach should be used in preference to setting a property for the number of storeys.

name: Year Of Construction
definition: Year of construction of this building, including expected year of completion.

name: Is Landmarked
definition: This builing is listed as a historic building (TRUE), or not (FALSE), or unknown.

name: Reference
definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

name: Entrance Level
definition: Indication whether this building storey is an entrance level to the building (TRUE), or (FALSE) if otherwise.

name: Above Ground
definition: Indication whether this building storey is fully above ground (TRUE), or below ground (FALSE), or partially above and below ground (UNKNOWN) - as in sloped terrain.

name: Net Area Planned
definition: Total planned net area for the space. Used for programming the space.

name: Market Category
definition: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

name: Market Sub Category
definition: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise

name: Planning Control Status
definition: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

name: Narrative Text
definition: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description

name: Vacancy Rate In Category Now
definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category currently

name: Tenure Modes Available Now
definition: A list of the tenure modes that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

name: Market Sub Categories Available Now
definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

name: Rental Rates In Category Now
definition: Range of the cost rates for property currently available in the required category.

name: Vacancy Rate In Category Future
definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category expected in the future

name: Tenure Modes Available Future
definition: A list of the tenure modes that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

name: Market Sub Categories Available Future
definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

name: Rental Rates In Category Future
definition: Range of the cost rates for property expected to be available in the future in the required category.

name: Water Storage Rate Per Person
definition: The volume of domestic water that needs to be stored per person.

name: One Day Potable Water
definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for human use for one day in the event of water supply failure.

name: One Day Essential Water
definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for uninterrupted water supply to essential areas for one day in the event of water supply failure. An essential area is considered to be a part of a building carrying out a critical function and that is unable to operate in the intended manner without a water supply.

name: One Day Cooling Tower Makeup Water
definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply make up water to the cooling towers in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

name: One Day Process Or Production Water
definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water for process or production requirements in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

name: Fragility Rating
definition: Indication on the fragility of the covering (e.g., under fire conditions).  It is given according to the national building code that might provide a classification for fragility.

name: Permeability
definition:
Ratio of the permeability of the ceiling.
The ration can be used to indicate an open ceiling (that enables identification of whether ceiling construction should be considered as impeding distribution of sprinkler water, light etc. from installations within the ceiling area) .

name: Tile Length
definition: Length of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Tile Width
definition: Width of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Fire Rating
definition: Fire rating given according to the national fire safety classification

name: Acoustic Rating
definition:
Acoustic rating for this object.
It is giving according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ration (instead of providing full sound absorbtion values).

name: Flammability Rating
definition:
Flammability Rating for this object.
It is given according to the national building code that governs the rating of flammability for materials.

name: Surface Spread Of Flame
definition: Surface spread of flame characteristics.

name: Combustible
definition: Indication whether the object is made from combustible material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Total Thickness
definition: Thickness of the covering, The thickness information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Has Non Skid Surface
definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent slippery (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Anti Static Surface
definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent electrostatic charge (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Layer Name
definition: Identifier of the layer name within the sending application.

name: Colour
definition: Significant colour definition of the whole element for all shape representations, it is given for highlighting/differentiation purposes, full colour representation of individual geometric representation items, using the IFC2x2 presentation schemas, always takes precedence. In case of several colour information available (line, upper/lower surface, etc.) the sending application shall identify the most significant single colour to be included,

name: Shading Device Type
definition: Specifies the type of shading device.

name: Inclination
definition: Inclination of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: Vertical = 0', horizontal = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Tilt Range
definition: The minimum and maximum angles of possible tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

name: Average Solar Transmittance
definition: Overall or average ratio of the solar flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

name: Average Visible Transmittance
definition: Overall or average ratio of the visible spectral flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

name: Reflectance
definition: The ratio of reflected power to incident power.

name: Roughness
definition: A measure of the vertical deviations of the surface.

name: Purpose
definition: Enumeration defining the purpose of the flow meter occurrence.

name: Fire Exit
definition:
Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
Here it defines an exit stair in accordance to the national building code.

name: Protected Opening
definition: Indication whether the opening is considered to be protected under fire safety considerations. If (TRUE) it counts as a protected opening under the applicable building code, (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Parallel Jambs
definition: Indicated, whether the jambs of an opening in a curved building element are intended to be parallel (TRUE) or are radial (FALSE). Radial means, that the extension of the jambs are rays through the axis of the revolution forming the curved building element.

name: Layer Quantity
definition: Quantity take-off information specific to a single layer of the element,  if multiple layer information is passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LayerQuantity1, ayerQuantity2, …

name: Local Context
definition: Local context information for the take-off quantity, if multiple information items are passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LocalContext1, LocalContext2, …

name: Buildable Area
definition: The area of utilization expressed as a minimum value and a maximum value  - according to local building codes.

name: Total Area
definition: Total exposed area of the roof

name: Building Height Limit
definition: Calculated maximum height of buildings on this site - according to local building codes.

name: Floor Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

name: Wall Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

name: Ceiling Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

name: Skirting Board
definition: Label to indicate the material or construction of the skirting board around the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.

name: Publicly Accessible
definition: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as a publicly accessible space, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Handicap Accessible
definition:
Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. 
Set to (TRUE) if this stair is rated as handicap accessible  according the local building codes, otherwise (FALSE). Accessibility maybe provided by additional means.

name: Concealed Flooring
definition: Indication whether this space is declared to be a concealed flooring (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed flooring is normally meant to be the space beneath a raised floor.

name: Concealed Ceiling
definition: Indication whether this space is declared to be a concealed ceiling (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed ceiling is normally meant to be the space between a slab and a suspended ceiling.

name: Fire Risk Factor
definition: Fire Risk factor assigned to the space according to local building regulations.

name: Fire Hazard Factor
definition: Fire hazard code of the space. The coding depends on the national fire safety regulations.

name: Flammable Storage
definition: Indication whether the space is intended to serve as a storage of flammable material (which is regarded as such by the presiding building code. (TRUE) indicates yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Air Pressurization
definition: Indication whether the space is required to have pressurized air (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Artificial Lighting
definition: Indication whether this space  requires artificial lighting (as natural lighting would be not sufficient). (TRUE) indicates yes (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Illuminance
definition: Required average illuminance value for this space.

name: Occupancy Number Peak
definition: Maximal number of people required for the activity assigned to this space in peak time.

name: Occupancy Time Per Day
definition: The amount of time during the day that the activity is required within this space.

name: Area Per Occupant
definition: Design occupancy loading for this type of usage assigned to this space.

name: Minimum Headroom
definition: Headroom required for the activity assigned to this space.

name: Is Outlook Desirable
definition: An indication of whether the outlook is desirable (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE)

name: Parking Use
definition: Identifies the type of transporation for which the parking space is designed. Values are not predefined but might include car, compact car, motorcycle, bicycle, truck, bus etc.

name: Parking Units
definition: Indicates the number of transporation units of the type specified by the property ParkingUse that may be accommodated within the space. Generally, this value should default to 1 unit. However, where the parking space is for motorcycles or bicycles, provision may be made for more than one unit in the space.

name: Is One Way
definition: Indicates whether the parking aisle is designed for oneway traffic (TRUE) or twoway traffic (FALSE).

name: Space Temperature Max
definition: Temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Space Temperature Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Space Temperature Summer Max
definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Space Temperature Summer Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Space Temperature Winter Max
definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Space Temperature Winter Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Space Humidity
definition: Humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Space Humidity Summer
definition: Humidity of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Space Humidity Winter
definition: Humidity of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period that is required from user/designer view point.

name: Discontinued Heating
definition: Indication whether discontinued heating is required/desirable from user/designer view point. (TRUE) if yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Natural Ventilation
definition: Indication whether the space is required to have natural ventilation (TRUE) or mechanical ventilation (FALSE).

name: Natural Ventilation Rate
definition: Indication of the requirement of a particular natural air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

name: Mechanical Ventilation Rate
definition: Indication of the requirement of a particular mechanical air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

name: Air Conditioning
definition: Indication whether this space requires air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Air Conditioning Central
definition:
Indication whether the space  requires a central air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
It should only be given, if the property "AirConditioning" is set to TRUE.

name: Clear Width
definition: The width of the formed space in the duct.

name: Clear Height
definition:
Clear height of the object (elevator).  
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Span
definition:
Clear span for this object.
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Is External
definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

name: Load Bearing
definition: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Thermal Transmittance
definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
It applies to the total door construction.

name: Security Rating
definition:
Index based rating system indicating security level.
It is giving according to the national building code.

name: Infiltration
definition: Infiltration flowrate of outside air for the filler object based on the area of the filler object at a pressure level of 50 Pascals. It shall be used, if the length of all joints is unknown.

name: Glazing Area Fraction
definition:
Fraction of the glazing area relative to the total area of the filling element. 
It shall be used, if the glazing area is not given separately for all panels within the filling element.

name: Self Closing
definition: Indication whether this object is designed to close automatically after use (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Smoke Stop
definition: Indication whether the object is designed to provide a smoke stop (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Glass Layers
definition: Number of glass layers within the frame. E.g. "2" for double glazing.

name: Glass Thickness1
definition: Thickness of the first (inner) glass layer.

name: Glass Thickness2
definition: Thickness of the second (intermediate or outer) glass layer.

name: Glass Thickness3
definition: Thickness of the third (outer) glass layer.

name: Fill Gas
definition: Name of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

name: Glass Color
definition: Color (tint) selection for this glazing. It is given for information purposes only.

name: Is Tempered
definition: Indication whether the glass is tempered (TRUE) or not (FALSE) .

name: Is Laminated
definition: Indication whether the glass is layered with other materials (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Is Coated
definition: Indication whether the glass is coated with a material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Is Wired
definition: Indication whether the glass includes a contained wire mesh to prevent break-in (TRUE) or not (FALSE)

name: Translucency
definition: Fraction of the visible light that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

name: Reflectivity
definition: Fraction of the visible light that is reflected by the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

name: Beam Radiation Transmittance
definition: Direct solar radiation transmittance that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit, often referred to as (Tsol).

name: Solar Heat Gain Transmittance
definition: Total solar heat transmittance that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit, often referred to as (SHGC):.

name: Thermal Transmittance Summer
definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Summer thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value)

name: Thermal Transmittance Winter
definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Winter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value)

name: External Shading Coefficient
definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the outside shading device. It is a value without unit.

name: Internal Shading Coefficient
definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the inside shading device, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit.

name: Inset Shading Coefficient
definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the shading device inside the glazing, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit.

name: Required Headroom
definition: Required headroom clearance for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements

name: Required Slope
definition:
Required sloping angle of the object  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
Required maximum slope for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements

name: Headroom
definition:
Actual headroom clearance for the passageway according to the current design. 
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Projected Area
definition: Area of the roof projected onto a 2D horizontal plane

name: Compartmentation
definition: Indication whether the object is designed to serve as a fire compartmentation (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Pitch Angle
definition: Angle of the slab to the horizontal when used as a component for the roof (specified as 0 degrees or not asserted for cases where the slab is not used as a roof component).

name: Number Of Riser
definition: Total number of the risers included in the stair flight

name: Number Of Treads
definition: Total number of treads included in the stair flight

name: Riser Height
definition:
Vertical distance from tread to tread. 
The riser height is supposed to be equal for all steps of a stair or stair flight.

name: Tread Length
definition:
Horizontal distance from the front of the thread to the front of the next tread. 
The tread length is supposed to be equal for all steps of the stair or stair flight at the walking line.

name: Nosing Length
definition: Horizontal distance from the front of the tread to the riser underneath. It is the overhang of the tread.

name: Walking Line Offset
definition:
Offset of the walking line from the inner side of the flight. 
Note: the walking line may have a own shape representation (in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence).

name: Tread Length At Offset
definition:
Length of treads at a given offset.
Walking line position is given by the 'WalkingLineOffset'. The resulting value should normally be identical with TreadLength, it may be given in addition, if the walking line offset for building code calculations is different from that used in design.

name: Tread Length At Inner Side
definition:
Minimum length of treads at the inner side of the winder. 
Only relevant in case of winding flights, for straight flights it is identical with IfcStairFlight.TreadLength. It is a pre-calculated value, in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence.

name: Waist Thickness
definition: Minimum thickness of the stair flight, measured perpendicular to the slope of the flight to the inner corner of riser and tread. It is a pre-calculated value, in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence.

name: Extend To Structure
definition: Indicates whether the object extend to the structure above (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Description
definition: Description of the reinforcement.

name: Air Side System Type
definition: This enumeration specifies the basic types of possible air side systems (e.g., Constant Volume, Variable Volume, etc.)

name: Air Side System Distribution Type
definition: This enumeration defines the basic types of air side systems (e.g., SingleDuct, DualDuct, Multizone, etc.)

name: Total Airflow
definition: The total design supply air flowrate required for the system for either heating or cooling conditions, whichever is greater.

name: Energy Gain Total
definition: The total amount of energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level total energy gains.

name: Airflow Sensible
definition: The air flowrate required to satisfy the sensible peak loads.

name: Energy Gain Sensible
definition: The sum of total energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level sensible energy gains.

name: Energy Loss
definition: The sum of energy losses for the spaces served by the system during the peak heating conditions.

name: Lighting Diversity
definition: Lighting diversity.

name: Infiltration Diversity Summer
definition: Diversity factor for Summer infiltration.

name: Infiltration Diversity Winter
definition: Diversity factor for Winter infiltration.

name: Appliance Diversity
definition: Diversity of appliance load.

name: Load Safety Factor
definition: Load safety factor.

name: Heating Temperature Delta
definition: Heating temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates

name: Cooling Temperature Delta
definition: Cooling temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates

name: Ventilation
definition: Required outside air ventilation.

name: Fan Power
definition: Fan motor loads contributing to the cooling load.

name: Wall Material
definition:
The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

name: Wall Thickness
definition:
The thickness of the chamber wall construction
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

name: Base Material
definition:
The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

name: Base Thickness
definition:
The thickness of the chamber base construction
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed at a single thickness.

name: Access Cover Material
definition:
The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

name: Access Cover Load Rating
definition: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating)

name: Chamber Length Or Radius
definition: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

name: Chamber Width
definition: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

name: Soffit Level
definition: Level of the highest internal part of the cross section. (BS6100 250 8002)

name: With Backdrop
definition: Indicates whether the chamber has a backdrop or tumbling bay (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Access Length Or Radius
definition: The length of the chamber access cover or, where the plan shape of the cover is circular, the radius.

name: Access Width
definition: The width of the chamber access cover where the plan shape of the cover is not circular.

name: Depth
definition: The depth of the trench.

name: Is Shallow
definition: Indicates whether the chamber has been designed as being shallow (TRUE) or deep (FALSE).

name: Has Steps
definition: Indicates whether the chamber has steps (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Port Number
definition: The index of the port as it relates to the related object. Each index must be unique for any given related object.

name: Has Sound Attentuation
definition: TRUE if the coil has sound attenuation, FALSE if it does not.

name: Number Of Panels
definition: Number of panels.

name: Is Combustible
definition: Combustibility (YES it is combustible or NO it is not combustible).

name: Sizing Method
definition:
Identifies whether the damper is sized nominally or with exact measurements:
NOMINAL: Nominal sizing method. 
EXACT: Exact sizing method.

name: Absolute Roughness Factor
definition: The absolute roughness factor of the duct fitting.

name: Has Liner
definition: TRUE if the fitting has interior duct insulating lining, FALSE if it does not.

name: Interior Roughness Coefficient
definition: The interior roughness coefficient of the pipe segment.

name: Impeller Diameter
definition: Diameter of pump impeller - used to scale performance of geometrically similar pumps.

name: Discharge Type
definition:
Defines the type of connection at the fan discharge.
Duct: Discharge into ductwork.
Screen: Discharge into screen outlet.
Louver: Discharge into a louver.
Damper: Discharge into a damper.

name: Application Of Fan
definition:
The functional application of the fan:
SUPPLYAIR: Supply air fan. 
RETURNAIR: Return air fan. 
EXHAUSTAIR: Exhaust air fan. 
OTHER: Other type of application not defined above.

name: Coil Position
definition:
Defines the relationship between a fan and a coil.
DrawThrough: Fan located downstream of the coil.
BlowThrough: Fan located upstream of the coil.

name: Motor Position
definition:
Defines the location of the motor relative to the air stream.
InAirStream: Fan motor is in the air stream.
OutOfAirStream: Fan motor is out of the air stream.

name: Fan Mounting Type
definition: Defines the method of mounting the fan in the building.

name: Fraction Of Motor Heat To Air Stream
definition: Fraction of the motor heat released into the fluid flow.

name: Discharge Position
definition:
Centrifugal fan discharge position:
TOPHORIZONTAL: Top horizontal discharge. 
TOPANGULARDOWN: Top angular down discharge. 
DOWNBLAST: Downblast discharge. 
BOTTOMANGULARDOWN: Bottom angular down discharge. 
BOTTOMHORIZONTAL: Bottom horizontal discharge. 
BOTTOMANGULARUP: Bottom angular up discharge. 
UPBLAST: Upblast discharge. 
TOPANGULARUP: Top angular up discharge. 
OTHER: Other type of fan arrangement.

name: Direction Of Rotation
definition:
The direction of the centrifugal fan wheel rotation when viewed from the drive side of the fan:
CLOCKWISE: Clockwise. 
COUNTERCLOCKWISE: Counter-clockwise. 
OTHER: Other type of fan rotation.

name: Base Type
definition:
Defines general types of pump bases:
FRAME: Frame. 
BASE: Base. 
NONE: There is no pump base, such as an inline pump. 
OTHER: Other type of pump base.

name: Drive Connection Type
definition:
The way the pump drive mechanism is connected to the pump:
DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive. 
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive. 
COUPLING: Coupling. 
OTHER: Other type of drive connection.

name: Gradient
definition: The gradient of the pipe segment.

name: Invert Elevation
definition: The invert elevation relative to the datum established for the project.

name: Tank Composition
definition:
Defines the level of element composition where:

COMPLEX = A set of elementary units aggregated together to fulfill the overall  required purpose.
ELEMENT = A single elementary unit that may exist of itself or as an aggregation of partial units..
PARTIAL

name: Has Ladder
definition:
Indication of whether the tank is provided with a ladder (set TRUE) for access to the top. If no ladder is provided then value is set FALSE.

Note: No indication is given of the type of ladder (gooseneck etc.)

name: Has Visual Indicator
definition: Indication of whether the tank is provided with a visual indicator (set TRUE) that shows the water level in the tank. If no visual indicator is provided then value is set FALSE.

name: Airflow Type
definition: Enumeration defining the functional type of air flow through the terminal.

name: Heating Dry Bulb
definition: Inside dry bulb temperature for heating design

name: Heating Wet Bulb
definition: Outside wet bulb temperature for heating design

name: Heating Design Day
definition: The month, day and time that has been selected for the heating design calculations.

name: Cooling Dry Bulb
definition: Inside dry bulb temperature for cooling design

name: Cooling Wet Bulb
definition: Outside wet bulb temperature for cooling design

name: Cooling Design Day
definition: The month, day  and time that has been selected for the cooling design calculations.

name: Weather Data Station
definition: The site weather data station description or reference to the data source from which weather data was obtained for use in calculations.

name: Weather Data Date
definition: The date for which the weather data was gathered.

name: Building Thermal Exposure
definition: The thermal exposure expected by the building based on surrounding site conditions.

name: Prevailing Wind Direction
definition: The prevailing wind angle direction measured from True North (0 degrees) in a clockwise direction.

name: Prevailing Wind Velocity
definition: The design wind velocity coming from the direction specified by the PrevailingWindDirection attribute.

name: Cooling Design Airflow
definition: The air flowrate required during the peak cooling conditions.

name: Heating Design Airflow
definition: The air flowrate required during the peak heating conditions, but could also be determined by minimum ventilation requirement or minimum air change requirements.

name: Total Sensible Heat Gain
definition: The total sensible heat or energy gained by the space during the peak cooling conditions.

name: Total Heat Gain
definition: The total amount of heat or energy gained by the space at the time of the space's peak cooling conditions.

name: Total Heat Loss
definition: The total amount of heat or energy lost by the space at the time of the space's peak heating conditions.

name: Cooling Relative Humidity
definition: Inside relative humidity for cooling design.

name: Heating Relative Humidity
definition: Inside relative humidity for heating design.

name: Ventilation Air Flowrate
definition: Ventilation outside air requirement for the space.

name: Exhaust Air Flowrate
definition: Design exhaust air flow rate for the space.

name: Ceiling RAPlenum
definition: Ceiling plenum used for return air or not. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Boundary Area Heat Loss
definition: Heat loss per unit area for the boundary object. This is a design input value for use in the absence of calculated load data.

name: Total Cooling Load
definition: The peak total cooling load for the building, zone or space.

name: Total Heating Load
definition: The peak total heating load for the building, zone or space.

name: Occupancy Diversity
definition: Diversity factor that may be applied to the number of people in the space.

name: Outside Air Per Person
definition: Design quantity of outside air to be provided per person in the space.

name: Receptacle Load Intensity
definition: Average power use intensity of appliances and other non-HVAC equipment.in the space per unit area.(PowerMeasure/IfcAreaMeasure)

name: Appliance Percent Load To Radiant
definition: Percent of sensible load to radiant heat.

name: Lighting Load Intensity
definition: Average lighting load intensity in the space per unit area (PowerMeasure/IfcAreaMeasure)

name: Lighting Percent Load To Return Air
definition: Percent of lighting load to the return air plenum.

name: Heat
definition: The amount of heat energy consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Electricity
definition: The amount of electricity consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Water
definition: The amount of water consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Fuel
definition: The amount of fuel consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Steam
definition: The amount of steam consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Anchor Bolt Length
definition: The length of the anchor bolt.

name: Anchor Bolt Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the anchor bolt bar(s).

name: Anchor Bolt Thread Length
definition: The length of the threaded part of the anchor bolt.

name: Anchor Bolt Protrusion Length
definition: The length of the protruding part of the anchor bolt.

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Width
definition: The width of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Depth
definition: The depth of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Casing Height
definition: The height of the column shoe casing.

name: Column Shoe Casing Width
definition: The width of the column shoe casing.

name: Column Shoe Casing Depth
definition: The depth of the column shoe casing.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Length
definition: The length of the L-shaped corner plate.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the L-shaped corner plate.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane Z
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane Z.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane X
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane X.

name: Diagonal Truss Height
definition: The overall height of the truss connector.

name: Diagonal Truss Length
definition: The overall length of the truss connector.

name: Diagonal Truss Cross Bar Spacing
definition: The spacing between diagonal cross-bar sections.

name: Diagonal Truss Base Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

name: Diagonal Truss Secondary Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

name: Diagonal Truss Cross Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the diagonal cross-bars.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Length
definition: The length of the L-shaped edge plate.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the L-shaped edge plate.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane Z
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane Z.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane X
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane X.

name: Fixing Socket Type Reference
definition: Type reference for the fixing socket according to local standards.

name: Fixing Socket Height
definition: The overall height of the fixing socket.

name: Fixing Socket Thread Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the thread.

name: Fixing Socket Thread Length
definition: The length of the threaded part of the fixing socket.

name: Ladder Truss Height
definition: The overall height of the truss connector.

name: Ladder Truss Length
definition: The overall length of the truss connector.

name: Ladder Truss Cross Bar Spacing
definition: The spacing between the straight cross-bars.

name: Ladder Truss Base Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

name: Ladder Truss Secondary Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

name: Ladder Truss Cross Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the straight cross-bars.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Width
definition: The width of the standard fixing plate.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Depth
definition: The depth of the standard fixing plate.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the standard fixing plate.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the base plate.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Width
definition: The width of the base plate.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Length
definition: The length of the base plate.

name: Wire Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the wire.

name: Wire Embedding Length
definition: The length of the part of wire which is embedded in the precast concrete element.

name: Wire Loop Length
definition: The length of the fastening loop part of the wire.

name: Asset Accounting Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

name: Asset Tax Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

name: Asset Insurance Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

name: Seating Height
definition: The value of seating height if the chair height is not adjustable.

name: Highest Seating Height
definition: The value of seating height of high level if the chair height is adjustable.

name: Lowest Seating Height
definition: The value of seating height of low level if the chair height is adjustable.

name: Style
definition: Description of the furniture style

name: Main Color
definition: The main color of the furniture of this type

name: Worksurface Area
definition: The value of the work surface area of the desk..

name: With Lock
definition: Indicates whether the file cabinet is lockable (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Number Of Chairs
definition: Maximum number of chairs that can fit with the table for normal use.

name: Acquisition Date
definition: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

name: Bar Code
definition: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product

name: Serial Number
definition: The manufacturer's serial number for the precast concrete element.

name: Batch Reference
definition: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

name: Model Reference
definition: The name of the manufactured item as used by the manufacturer.

name: Model Label
definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

name: Manufacturer
definition: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

name: Production Year
definition: The year of production of the manufactured item.

name: Agreement Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of property agreement from which the type required may be set.

name: Identifier
definition: The identifier assigned to the agreement for the purposes of tracking.

name: Version
definition: The version number of the agreement that is identified

name: Version Date
definition: The date on which the version of the agreement became applicable

name: Property Name
definition: Addressing details of the property as stated within the agreement

name: Commencement Date
definition: Date on which the agreement commences

name: Termination Date
definition: Date on which the agreement terminates

name: Duration
definition: The period of time for the lease. Note that values should be given in year/day/month and not in hour/minute/second.

name: Options
definition: A statement of the options available in the agreement

name: Condition Commencement
definition: Condition of property provided on commencement of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

name: Restrictions
definition: Restrictions that may be placed by a  competent authority
