name: Condition Termination
definition: Condition of property required on termination of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

name: Mean Time Between Failure
definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

name: Risk Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

name: Nature Of Risk
definition:
An indication of the generic nature of the risk that might be encountered. 

NOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values that might be assigned to this property. An example might be 'Fall'  or 'Fall of grille unit' causing injury and damage to person and property

name: Sub Nature Of Risk1
definition:
A first subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk.

NOTE: Nature of risk may be identified in various ways depending upon the place where risk assessment takes place and according to local agreement. This property set allows for a generic nature of risk and up to two subsidiary natures. An example might be 'causing injury and damage'

name: Sub Nature Of Risk2
definition: A second subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk. An example might be 'o person and property'

name: Risk Cause
definition: A value that may be assigned to capture the cause or trigger for the risk. An example might be 'poor fixing'

name: Assessment Of Risk
definition:
Likelihood of risk event occurring.

Note  that assessment of risk may frequently be associated with the physical location of the object for which the risk is assessed.

name: Risk Consequence
definition: Indicates the level of severity of the consequences that the risk would have in case it happens

name: Risk Rating
definition: A general rating of the risk that may be determined from a combination of the risk assessment and risk consequence

name: Risk Owner
definition: A determination of who is the owner of the risk by reference to principal roles of organizations within a project. Determination of the specific organization should be by reference to instances of IfcActorRole assigned to instances of IfcOrganization (if assigned).

name: Affects Surroundings
definition:
Indicates wether the risk affects only to the person assigned to that task (FALSE) or if it can also affect to the people in the surroundings (TRUE).

For example, the process of painting would affect all the people in the vicinity of the process

name: Preventive Meassures
definition: Identifies preventive measures to be taken to mitigate risk

name: Is Used
definition: Indicates whether the element is being used in a workstation (= TRUE) or not.(= FALSE).

name: Group Code
definition: e.g. panels, worksurfaces, storage, etc.

name: Finishing
definition: The finishing applied to system furniture elements of this type e.g. walnut, fabric.

name: Has Opening
definition: indicates whether the panel has an opening (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Furniture Panel Type
definition: Available panel types from which that required may be selected.

name: Nominal Thickness
definition: The nominal thickness of the work surface.

name: Use Purpose
definition: The principal purpose for which the work surface is intended to be used e.g. writing/reading, computer, meeting, printer, reference files, etc.

name: Support Type
definition: Available support types from which that required may be selected.

name: Hanging Height
definition: The hanging height of the worksurface.

name: Shape Description
definition: A description of the shape of the work surface e.g. corner square, rectangle, etc.

name: Warranty Identifier
definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

name: Warranty Start Date
definition: The date on which the warranty commences

name: Warranty End Date
definition: The date on which the warranty expires.

name: Is Extended Warranty
definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

name: Warranty Period
definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

name: Point Of Contact
definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

name: Warranty Content
definition: The content of the warranty

name: Exclusions
definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

name: Change Description
definition: A general description of the change.

name: Reason For Change
definition: A description of the problem for why a change is needed.

name: Budget Source
definition: The budget source requested.

name: Product Description
definition: A textual description of the products that require the work.

name: Short Job Description
definition: Short description of the job requested.

name: Long Job Description
definition: Description of the job requested.

name: Work Type Requested
definition: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

name: Contractual Type
definition: The contractual type of the work.

name: If Not Accomplished
definition: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

name: Maintenace Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of maintenance that can be done from which the type that generates the maintenance work order may be set where:

ConditionBased = generated as a result of the condition of an asset or artefact being less than a determined value.
Corrective = generated as a result of an immediate and urgent need for maintenance action.
PlannedCorrective = generated as a result of immediate corrective action being needed but with sufficient time available for the work order to be included in maintenance planning.
Scheduled = generated as a result of a fixed, periodic maintenance requirement.

name: Fault Priority Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:

High = action is required urgently.
Medium = action can occur within a reasonable period of time.
Low = action can occur when convenient.

name: Location Priority Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:

High = action is required urgently.
Medium = action can occur within a reasonable period of time.
Low = action can occur when convenient.

name: Scheduled Frequency
definition: The period of time between expected instantiations of a work order that may have been predefined.

name: Move Description
definition: A textual description of the move required.

name: Is FOB
definition: Indication of whether contents of the purchase order are delivered 'Free on Board' (= True) or not (= False).

name: Ship Method
definition: Method of shipping that will be used for goods or services.

name: Structural Class
definition: The structural class defined for the concrete structure (e.g. '1').

name: Environmental Class
definition: The environmental class for the concrete structure (e.g. 'Y1')

name: Service Life
definition: Expected service life (usually measured in years)

name: Life Cycle Environmental Load
definition: Description of the life-cycle environmental load

name: Dimensional Accuracy Class
definition: Classification designation of the dimensional accuracy requirement according to local standards.

name: Construction Tolerance Class
definition: Classification designation of the on-site construction tolerances according to local standards.

name: Construction Type
definition: Designator for whether the concrete element is constructed on site or prefabricated. Allowed values are: 'Insitu' vs 'Precast'

name: Concrete Cover At Main Bars
definition: The protective concrete cover at the main reinforcing bars according to local building regulations.

name: Concrete Cover At Links
definition: The protective concrete cover at the reinforcement links according to local building regulations.

name: Total Concrete Quantity
definition: The total bulk quantity of concrete used for the precast concrete element expressed as the volume of concrete in cubic meter (m3).

name: Total Rebar Quantity
definition: The total bulk quantity of rebar per size used for the precast concrete element expressed as the mass measure of rebar in kg. Note: several complex properties of this type, one for each rebar size, may be attached to the Pset.

name: Total Accessory Quantity
definition: The total bulk quantity of accessories per type of accessory for the precast concrete element. The quantity may be expressed as number of items or mass measure in kg or both. Note: several complex properties of this type, one for each accessory type, may be attached to the Pset.

name: Form Surface
definition: Formwork surface area quantity. Several complex properties of this type may be attached to this Pset, one for each formwork subsurface with different properties.

name: External Surface
definition: External surface area quantity.Several complex properties of this type may be attached to this Pset, one for each external subsurface with different properties

name: Surface Description Doc Reference
definition: Reference to an external document describing the details of the surface of the concrete element, i.e. a drawing or textual document file.

name: Type Designator
definition: Type designator for the precast concrete element. The content depends on local standards. For instance in Finland it usually a one-letter acronym, e.g. P=Column, K=reinforced concrete beam,etc.

name: Production Lot Id
definition: The manufacturer's production lot identifier.

name: Element Weight
definition: The weight of the concrete element. Usually expressed in kg.

name: Element Gross Volume
definition: The gross volume of concrete element. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

name: Element Net Volume
definition: The net volume of concrete element. Openings, voids, chamfers, etc. are subtracted from the gross volume. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

name: Corner Chamfer
definition: The chamfer in the corners of the precast element. The chamfer is presumed to be equal in both directions.

name: Manufacturing Tolerance Class
definition: Classification designation of the manufacturing tolerances according to local standards.

name: Form Stripping Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete at form stripping time.

name: Lifting Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the concrete element is lifted.

name: Release Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the tendon stress is released. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

name: Minimum Allowable Support Length
definition: The minimum allowable support length.

name: Initial Tension
definition: The initial stress of the tendon. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

name: Tendon Relaxation
definition: The maximum allowable relaxation of the tendon (usually expressed as %/1000 h).This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

name: Transportation Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete required for transportation.

name: Support During Transport Description
definition: Textual description of how the concrete element is supported during transportation

name: Support During Transport Doc Reference
definition: Reference to an external document defining how the concrete element is supported during transportation

name: Hollow Core Plugging
definition: A descriptive label for how the hollow core ends are treated: they may be left open, closed with a plug, or sealed with cast concrete. Values would be, for example: 'Unplugged', 'Plugged', 'SealedWithConcrete'. This property applies to  hollow core slabs only.

name: XDirection Lower Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction lower bar.

name: YDirection Lower Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction lower bar.

name: XDirection Upper Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction upper bar.

name: YDirection Upper Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction upper bar.

name: Stirrup Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the stirrup bar.

name: Spacing Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the spacing bar.

name: Reinforcement Bar Type
definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar.

name: Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the hoop bar.

name: XDirection Tie Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The X direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

name: XDirection Tie Hoop Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction tie hoop bars.

name: YDirection Tie Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The Y direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

name: YDirection Tie Hoop Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction tie hoop bars.

name: Crossing Upper Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the crossing upper bar.

name: Crossing Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the crossing lower bar.

name: Long Outside Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long outside top bar.

name: Long Inside Center Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long inside center top bar.

name: Long Inside End Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long inside end top bar.

name: Short Outside Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short outside top bar.

name: Short Inside Center Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside center top bar.

name: Short Inside End Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside end top bar.

name: Long Outside Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long outside lower bar.

name: Long Inside Center Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long inside center lower bar.

name: Long Inside End Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the long inside end lower bar.

name: Short Outside Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short outside lower bar.

name: Short Inside Center Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside center lower bar.

name: Short Inside End Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside end lower bar.

name: Bar Allocation Type
definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar allocation.

name: Vertical Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the vertical bar.

name: Horizontal Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the horizontal bar.

name: BECBar Shape Code
definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the BEC standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...e (f...l), TD, u, v, u1, v1, aid_x, and aid_y are used.

name: BECCutting Length
definition: Usually calculated from the sum of the partial length parameters with corrections for the bendings.

name: BECShape Parameter_a
definition: Bar shape parameter a.

name: BECShape Parameter_b
definition: Bar shape parameter b.

name: BECShape Parameter_c
definition: Bar shape parameter c.

name: BECShape Parameter_d

name: BECShape Parameter_e
definition: Bar shape parameter e.

name: BECShape Parameter_f
definition: Bar shape parameter f.

name: BECShape Parameter_g
definition: Bar shape parameter g.

name: BECShape Parameter_h
definition: Bar shape parameter h.

name: BECShape Parameter_i
definition: Bar shape parameter i.

name: BECShape Parameter_j
definition: Bar shape parameter j.

name: BECShape Parameter_k
definition: Bar shape parameter k.

name: BECShape Parameter_l
definition: Bar shape parameter l.

definition: Bar bending angle parameter u.

name: BECBending Parameter_v
definition: Bar bending angle parameter v.

name: BECBending Parameter_u1
definition: Bar bending angle parameter u1.

name: BECBending Parameter_v1
definition: Bar bending angle parameter v1.

name: BECShape Aid_x
definition: Bar shape measure aid x.

name: BECShape Aid_y
definition: Bar shape measure aid y.

name: BECRoller Diameter
definition: Diameter of bending roller.

name: BS8666 Shape Code
definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the BS8666 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters A...E and r are used.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_A
definition: Bar shape parameter A.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_B
definition: Bar shape parameter B.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_C
definition: Bar shape parameter C.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_D
definition: Bar shape parameter D.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_E
definition: Bar shape parameter E.

name: BS8666 Shape Parameter_r
definition: Bar shape parameter r. Used for bending radius.

name: DIN135610 Shape Code
definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the DIN 1356 Teil 10 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...z are used.

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_a
definition: Bar shape parameter a. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter a0 (shape code B3)

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_b
definition: Bar shape parameter b. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter b0 (shape codes C2 and C3)

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_c
definition: Bar shape parameter c.

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_d
definition: Bar shape parameter d. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter d0 (shape code B3)

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_e
definition: Bar shape parameter e. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter e0 (shape codes A4 and C3)

name: DIN135610 Shape Parameter_z
definition: Bar shape parameter z.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Code
definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the ISO/CD 3766 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...e and R are used.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_a
definition: Bar shape parameter a.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_b
definition: Bar shape parameter b.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_c
definition: Bar shape parameter c.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_d
definition: Bar shape parameter d.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_e
definition: Bar shape parameter e.

name: ISOCD3766 Shape Parameter_R
definition: Bar shape parameter R. Used for bending radius.

name: ISOCD3766 Bending Start Hook
definition: The angle of the hook at start of the bar. If the property is not included the bar has no start hook. Note: this differs from how ISO/CD 3766 handles end hooks.

name: ISOCD3766 Bending End Hook
definition: The angle of the hook at end of the bar. If the property is not included  the bar has no end hook. Note: this differs from how ISO/CD 3766 handles end hooks.
